610.abstract: While recovering from injuries on the pastoral world of Saleucami, Captain Rex encounters a clone deserter living a quiet life, forcing the officer to question his own unwavering sense of duty.

611.abstract: After her lightsaber is stolen in the galactic capital's underworld, Ahsoka Tano must team up with an elderly Jedi Master, Tera Sinube, to track down the thief and recover her weapon.

612.abstract: Obi-Wan Kenobi travels to the neutral world of Mandalore to investigate rumors of a conspiracy, uncovering the resurgence of the violent Death Watch faction led by Pre Vizsla.

613.abstract: While escorting Duchess Satine Kryze to Coruscant aboard the starship Coronet, Jedi Knights Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker must thwart Separatist assassins and saboteurs.

614.abstract: On Coruscant, Duchess Satine Kryze fights to expose the Death Watch's plot in the Galactic Senate, while a Mandalorian assassin attempts to silence her permanently.

615.abstract: As the Clone Wars rage and the Empire rises, Director Orson Krennic manipulates his old friend, the brilliant but pacifist scientist Galen Erso, into researching kyber crystals for the Death Star project.

616.abstract: A young, vengeful Boba Fett infiltrates a group of clone cadets aboard a Republic cruiser, plotting to assassinate Jedi Master Mace Windu to avenge his father's death.

617.abstract: When Anakin Skywalker and Mace Windu are trapped in the wreckage of their starship on Vanqor, it falls to R2-D2 to navigate the dangerous planet and get a message to the Jedi Council.

618.abstract: Jedi Master Plo Koon and Ahsoka Tano track Boba Fett and his fellow bounty hunters to the pirate world of Florrum, leading to a tense hostage standoff and a confrontation with Hondo Ohnaka.

619.abstract: During a diplomatic visit, Senator Padmé Amidala uncovers a black market scheme poisoning Mandalorian children with contaminated tea, forcing her to investigate the widespread corruption.

620.abstract: Ahsoka Tano is assigned to teach at a Mandalorian military academy, where she and a group of cadets uncover a deep-seated conspiracy within the government.

621.abstract: Haunted by visions of an attempt on Padmé Amidala's life by the bounty hunter Aurra Sing, Ahsoka Tano struggles to convince the Jedi Council of the threat before it's too late.

622.abstract: General Grievous and Asajj Ventress lead a full-scale Separatist invasion of Kamino, forcing clone troopers Rex, Cody, Fives, and Echo to mount a desperate defense of their homeworld.

623.abstract: Jedi Master Yoda and a squad of clone commandos join forces with Wookiee warriors, including a young Chewbacca, to repel a Trandoshan slaver and Separatist droid attack.

633.abstract: When the daughters of Pantora's chairman are kidnapped by the Trade Federation, Ahsoka Tano and Senator Riyo Chuchi assist in a daring rescue mission.

634.abstract: In a scheme to free Ziro the Hutt, bounty hunter Cad Bane kidnaps C-3PO and R2-D2 to extract the blueprints for the Senate Building from their memory banks.

635.abstract: The notorious bounty hunter Cad Bane leads a team to seize control of the Senate Building, taking senators hostage to force the release of the crime lord Ziro the Hutt.

636.abstract: A retelling of the daring siege on the Galactic Senate, where bounty hunter Cad Bane holds senators captive to demand the freedom of Ziro the Hutt.

637.abstract: While accompanying Senator Amidala on a diplomatic mission, Jar Jar Binks and C-3PO stumble upon a Separatist spy aboard a luxurious space station.

638.abstract: The bumbling efforts of Jar Jar Binks and C-3PO to expose a Separatist agent cause chaos throughout a diplomatic conference on a neutral space station.

639.abstract: General Grievous travels to the swamp world of Xagobah to recruit a formidable warrior for the Separatist cause, only to find himself in a fight for his own survival.

640.abstract: Jedi Masters Obi-Wan Kenobi and the maverick Quinlan Vos must reluctantly team up to track down the escaped crime lord Ziro the Hutt, racing against bounty hunter Cad Bane for the prize.

641.abstract: Within the Jedi Temple, Master Yoda imparts a crucial lesson in patience and perspective to his frustrated student, Ahsoka Tano, during her lightsaber training.

642.abstract: Anakin Skywalker arranges a surprise meeting between his Padawan, Ahsoka Tano, and his secret wife, Senator Padmé Amidala, leading to a brief, shared moment of peace.

643.abstract: While visiting Senator Padmé Amidala's apartment, Ahsoka Tano's sharp instincts help her uncover and defeat a Clawdite shapeshifter who has taken the senator's place.

644.abstract: A collection of tales celebrating the courage and ingenuity of the galaxy's greatest heroines, from Leia Organa's leadership in the Rebellion to Rey's journey with the Force.

645.abstract: Ahsoka Tano and Padmé Amidala embark on a secret diplomatic mission to Alderaan, where they must work together to navigate political intrigue and avert a crisis.

646.abstract: Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano arrive on the planet Kiros to find its entire Togruta population has vanished, beginning an investigation into their mysterious disappearance.

647.abstract: The investigation into the missing colonists of Kiros leads Anakin and Ahsoka to uncover a sinister plot by the Zygerrian Slave Empire.

648.abstract: When Padmé Amidala's starfighter malfunctions during a flight over Coruscant, Ahsoka Tano must perform a daring mid-air stunt to bring the Senator to safety.

649.abstract: During a Jedi ceremony, Ahsoka Tano recalls a recent mission where she learned a valuable lesson about compassion after defying orders to help a creature in distress.

650.abstract: A collection of tales showcasing the bravery and resourcefulness of heroines like Rey, Leia Organa, and Ahsoka Tano as they face challenges across the galaxy.

651.abstract: Senator Padmé Amidala and Ahsoka Tano travel secretly to the Separatist capital to negotiate peace, discovering that the desire for an end to the war exists on both sides. Their efforts are undermined by shadowy figures profiting from the conflict.

652.abstract: Following a terrorist attack, Padmé Amidala and her allies in the Senate fight against a bill to fund millions of new clone troopers. They face immense political pressure and threats from those who wish the war to continue.

653.abstract: Senator Padmé Amidala works tirelessly to block a bill that would escalate the Clone Wars, facing political opposition and danger in the heart of the Republic.

654.abstract: When Senator Onaconda Farr is poisoned, Padmé Amidala and Bail Organa investigate the murder within the Senate itself, uncovering a conspiracy tied to the war effort.

655.abstract: Betrayed and left for dead by Count Dooku, Asajj Ventress returns to her homeworld of Dathomir to seek refuge with the Nightsisters. Under the guidance of Mother Talzin, she plots her revenge against her former master.

656.abstract: Asajj Ventress and the Nightsisters select a warrior from the Nightbrother clan, Savage Opress, to be their instrument of revenge against Count Dooku. Through dark magic, they transform him into a monstrous brute and present him to Dooku as a new apprentice.

657.abstract: Savage Opress proves to be a powerful but uncontrollable weapon, turning on both Count Dooku and Asajj Ventress. The ensuing three-way duel forces all combatants to flee, while Jedi Knights investigate the chaos.

658.abstract: Anakin Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Ahsoka Tano are drawn to a mysterious and powerful realm outside of known space. There they encounter a family of god-like Force-wielders who test Anakin's destiny as the Chosen One.

659.abstract: The Son, an embodiment of the dark side, kidnaps Ahsoka Tano and infects her with his power to turn her against her master. Anakin Skywalker must confront the dark side within himself to save his Padawan, leading to a tragic sacrifice.

660.abstract: As the Jedi attempt to escape the mystical realm of Mortis, the Son shows Anakin a horrifying vision of his future as Darth Vader. The Father sacrifices himself to strip the Son of his power, allowing Anakin to defeat him and restore balance.

661.abstract: Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker lead a rescue mission to a formidable Separatist prison known as the Citadel to free Jedi Master Even Piell. To infiltrate the facility, they and their clone troopers are frozen in carbonite.

662.abstract: Having freed Master Piell from the Citadel, the Jedi and their clone troopers must now escape the planet Lola Sayu. They face overwhelming odds as the prison's ruthless warden unleashes all his forces to stop them.

663.abstract: The rescue team's escape from Lola Sayu turns tragic as they suffer heavy losses, including the death of Master Even Piell. Before he dies, Piell entrusts his half of secret hyperspace route information to Ahsoka Tano.

664.abstract: Ahsoka Tano is captured by Trandoshan hunters and abandoned on a jungle moon to be hunted for sport. She must band together with other captured Jedi younglings to survive against the deadly predators.

665.abstract: Ahsoka Tano and her fellow Jedi captives find an unexpected ally in the form of the Wookiee warrior Chewbacca. Together, they launch a counter-offensive against their Trandoshan captors in a desperate bid for freedom.

666.abstract: A civil war erupts on the aquatic world of Mon Cala, with the Quarren aligning with the Separatists. The Republic sends Jedi and clone SCUBA troopers to aid Prince Lee-Char and prevent the planet from falling into enemy hands.

667.abstract: With Republic forces on the brink of defeat in the underwater battle for Mon Cala, the Gungan Grand Army intervenes to turn the tide of the conflict.

668.abstract: The Separatist commander Riff Tamson captures the Jedi and their allies, forcing the young Prince Lee-Char to rally his people and the Quarren to rise up and reclaim their world.

669.abstract: General Grievous arrives on the planet Lanteeb to claim a powerful energy source for the Separatist war machine, but is confronted by a lone Jedi Knight protecting a sacred temple.

670.abstract: The infamous pirate Hondo Ohnaka attempts to broker a lucrative deal between two warring factions, playing both sides for his own profit until Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi unexpectedly arrives.

671.abstract: The Gungans are tricked by a Separatist agent into marching on Theed, threatening a civil war on Naboo. Padmé Amidala and Anakin Skywalker must uncover the plot, leading to an unexpected capture of General Grievous.

672.abstract: C-3PO and R2-D2 accompany a Republic relief mission to the devastated planet of Aleen. The droids get separated and discover a hidden world beneath the planet's surface, where they must help resolve a conflict between two subterranean species.

673.abstract: After their mission on Aleen, C-3PO and R2-D2 are accidentally jettisoned into space and embark on a series of misadventures across multiple strange worlds.

674.abstract: The 501st Legion is sent to conquer the shadowy world of Umbara under the command of the rigid Jedi General Pong Krell. Krell's reckless strategies and disregard for clone lives immediately cause friction with Captain Rex.

675.abstract: General Krell's high-casualty tactics on Umbara push the clone troopers of the 501st to their limits. Captain Rex finds his loyalty tested as he must choose between following orders and protecting the lives of his men.

676.abstract: After a direct order from General Krell leads to a near-disaster, several clone troopers, led by Fives and Jesse, decide to defy his command and carry out a covert mission on their own.

677.abstract: General Krell tricks two clone battalions into firing on one another, revealing his betrayal and fall to the dark side. Captain Rex must rally his troops to mutiny against the fallen Jedi and bring him to justice.

678.abstract: During the brutal campaign on the world of Umbara, Captain Rex and the 501st Legion are forced to question their orders when their new commander, Jedi General Pong Krell, proves to be a greater threat than the enemy.

679.abstract: A group of clone troopers, known as Zero Company, find themselves stranded behind enemy lines after a disastrous battle and must rely on their brotherhood to survive.

680.abstract: A squad of B1 battle droids find themselves in a chaotic battle, questioning their programming and purpose amidst the carnage of the Clone Wars.

681.abstract: Jedi Master Yoda takes a group of younglings on a training exercise to a remote world, where a simple game of hide-and-seek turns into a valuable lesson about the Living Force.

682.abstract: Seeking to prove his superiority over the Jedi, General Grievous is drawn to a mysterious Force verge, where he confronts only his own failures and the emptiness of his cybernetic existence.

683.abstract: Anakin, Obi-Wan, and Ahsoka arrive on the planet Kiros to find its entire population has vanished. They discover the colonists have been taken by Zygerrian slavers, forcing the Jedi to confront a resurgent slave empire.

684.abstract: To locate the missing Togruta colonists, Anakin Skywalker poses as a slaver with Ahsoka as his prize to infiltrate a Zygerrian slave auction, forcing him to confront his own past.

685.abstract: After being captured by the Zygerrians, Obi-Wan Kenobi and Captain Rex are sent to a brutal labor camp. Anakin Skywalker and Republic forces must launch a full-scale assault to free their friends and the enslaved Togruta people.

686.abstract: Ahsoka Tano is drawn into a conflict involving Lux Bonteri and the Mandalorian extremist group, Death Watch. Her loyalties are tested when she sees the darker side of the Separatist movement.

687.abstract: To uncover a Separatist plot to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine, Obi-Wan Kenobi fakes his own death and goes deep undercover as the bounty hunter Rako Hardeen.

688.abstract: While undercover, Obi-Wan Kenobi must gain the trust of bounty hunter Cad Bane and criminal mastermind Moralo Eval. Meanwhile, a vengeful Anakin Skywalker relentlessly pursues his friend's supposed killer.

689.abstract: Count Dooku tests a group of the galaxy's best bounty hunters, including the disguised Obi-Wan Kenobi, to select a team for his plot against the Chancellor. The hunters must survive a series of deadly trials in a shifting maze known as 'The Box.'

690.abstract: A Separatist plot to kidnap Supreme Chancellor Palpatine during the Festival of Light on Naboo is uncovered, forcing the Jedi to protect him. Obi-Wan Kenobi, disguised as the assassin Rako Hardeen, must thwart the conspiracy from within.

691.abstract: A dossier recounts the notorious career of the Duros bounty hunter Cad Bane, detailing his rise to prominence and his ruthless methods that made him one of the most feared mercenaries in the galaxy during the Clone Wars.

692.abstract: In retaliation for Asajj Ventress's defiance, Count Dooku orders General Grievous to wipe out the Nightsisters of Dathomir. The resulting battle leads to the near-extinction of the clan, forcing Ventress to find a new path.

693.abstract: During the Clone Wars, a young Morgan Elsbeth survives the massacre of her Nightsister clan by General Grievous's droid army. She is rescued by the neighboring Mountain Clan, who teach her to channel her anger and begin her on a new, darker path.

694.abstract: A disillusioned Asajj Ventress joins a team of bounty hunters, including a young Boba Fett, on a mission to protect valuable cargo on a speeding subtram. She must prove her worth and decide where her loyalties lie in the galactic underworld.

695.abstract: Reeling from the destruction of her clan on Dathomir, Asajj Ventress contemplates her future, grappling with her losses and the uncertain path that lies ahead for a lone survivor.

696.abstract: Driven by Mother Talzin's magic, Savage Opress travels to the junk world of Lotho Minor in search of his long-lost brother. He discovers a broken, spider-like Maul, driven mad by a decade of isolation and a thirst for revenge.

697.abstract: After Mother Talzin restores his mind and body, Maul, alongside his brother Savage Opress, embarks on a campaign of terror to lure Obi-Wan Kenobi into a trap. The vengeful Zabrak brothers confront the Jedi Master, forcing an unlikely alliance between Kenobi and Asajj Ventress.

698.abstract: A chronicle of Maul's survival after his defeat on Naboo, his descent into madness on the junk world of Lotho Minor, and his eventual restoration by the magic of Mother Talzin, setting him on a path of vengeance against Obi-Wan Kenobi.

699.abstract: Anakin Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Ahsoka Tano are dispatched to Onderon to train a group of local rebels, led by Steela and Saw Gerrera, in their fight against the Separatist-backed monarchy.

700.abstract: Under the guidance of the Jedi, the Onderon rebels, led by Steela Gerrera, launch their first major offensive against the Separatist droid forces occupying the capital city of Iziz.

701.abstract: As the Onderon rebellion gains momentum, the rebels focus on winning the hearts and minds of the people by deposing the puppet king, Sanjay Rash.

702.abstract: The Onderon rebellion reaches its climax as the rebels launch a final, decisive battle to liberate their world from Separatist control. The victory comes at a great personal cost, marking a turning point for the rebellion.

703.abstract: Ahsoka Tano escorts a group of Jedi younglings to the sacred world of Ilum for The Gathering. Each initiate must enter the Crystal Caves and face their inner fears to find the kyber crystal that will become the heart of their lightsaber.

704.abstract: While returning from Ilum, the younglings' ship is attacked by Hondo Ohnaka's pirates, who seek to steal their newly acquired kyber crystals. The initiates must use their wits and burgeoning skills to defend their vessel.

705.abstract: After Ahsoka is captured by Hondo, the younglings mount a daring rescue mission to the pirate stronghold on Florrum, posing as a traveling circus troupe to infiltrate the base.

706.abstract: The Separatist invasion of Florrum forces an unlikely alliance between the Jedi younglings and Hondo Ohnaka's pirates against their common enemy, General Grievous. The younglings finally escape, having proven their courage.

707.abstract: A reflection on the journey of the Jedi younglings to Ilum and back, detailing their trials in acquiring their kyber crystals and their unexpected confrontation with pirates, which tested their resolve on the path to becoming Jedi Knights.

708.abstract: A diminutive colonel commands a special unit of droids, including R2-D2, on a top-secret mission to steal a Separatist encryption module from a dreadnought. The success of this unlikely team is critical to a major Republic offensive.

709.abstract: After their ship is destroyed, R2-D2 and the droids of D-Squad are stranded in a desolate region of space known as the Void. They soon discover they are not alone, encountering a lost Republic clone commando.

710.abstract: The droids discover a Separatist plot on Abafar and must help the amnesiac clone commando Gregor remember who he is to inspire him to fight once more.

711.abstract: D-Squad hijacks a Separatist shuttle, only to discover it is a flying bomb intended to destroy a Republic strategy conference. The droids must work together to neutralize the threat before it reaches its target.

712.abstract: Newly restored by Nightsister magic, Maul's fractured mind focuses on a single, burning purpose: revenge against the Jedi who took everything from him. He and his brother Savage Opress set a trap, eager to make Obi-Wan Kenobi suffer.

713.abstract: A lone B1 battle droid participates in General Grievous's devastating assault on the Nightsisters of Dathomir. Through its simple photoreceptors, the brutal efficiency and eerie magic of the conflict are witnessed from a unique perspective.

714.abstract: Maul and Savage Opress begin building a criminal empire by forcibly recruiting Hondo Ohnaka's pirates. Their rampage attracts the attention of Obi-Wan Kenobi, leading to a fierce confrontation.

715.abstract: Maul and Savage Opress form an alliance with Pre Vizsla's Death Watch, uniting the galaxy's major crime syndicates to form the Shadow Collective. Their goal: the conquest of Mandalore.

716.abstract: As the Shadow Collective tightens its grip on the underworld, Maul dispatches a team of bounty hunters to Ord Mantell to capture a crime lord's son, demonstrating the ruthlessness and reach of his new criminal empire.

717.abstract: The Shadow Collective stages attacks across Sundari, creating chaos that allows Death Watch to 'save' the populace and seize control from Duchess Satine Kryze. Pre Vizsla's alliance with Maul proves dangerously unstable.

718.abstract: Maul challenges Pre Vizsla for leadership of Mandalore, seizing the throne after a brutal duel. He enacts a cruel revenge upon Obi-Wan Kenobi, a tragedy that draws the attention of his former master, Darth Sidious.

719.abstract: A reflection on Obi-Wan Kenobi's painful history with Mandalore, culminating in his desperate attempt to save Duchess Satine from the clutches of Maul. The events underscore the personal cost of the war for the Jedi.

720.abstract: A deadly bombing at the Jedi Temple hangar leads to a complex investigation, with Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano assigned to find the culprits. The clues point to a conspiracy that may involve a Jedi.

721.abstract: When the key suspect in the Temple bombing is murdered, Ahsoka Tano is framed for the crime. Forced to flee from her own allies, she delves into the Coruscant underworld to clear her name.

722.abstract: Before the tragic events that would tear them apart, Jedi Padawans Ahsoka Tano and Barriss Offee team up for a mission on Coruscant. Their friendship and differing philosophies are highlighted as they confront a local threat.

723.abstract: Hunted in the depths of Coruscant's underworld, Ahsoka Tano makes a desperate pact with her old adversary, Asajj Ventress, to uncover the truth behind the conspiracy against her.

724.abstract: Expelled from the Jedi Order, Ahsoka Tano is put on trial for treason. As Anakin frantically searches for the true culprit, Ahsoka's faith in the Jedi is shattered, leading her to make a life-altering decision.

725.abstract: During the Outer Rim Sieges, Padawan Caleb Dume and his master, Depa Billaba, lead clone forces on the icy world of Mygeeto. The brutal realities of frontline combat test the young Jedi's resolve.

726.abstract: On Mygeeto, Caleb Dume struggles with the morality of the war and a growing sense of unease. A tense confrontation with the Separatist General Kleeve forces Caleb to question the Jedi's role and methods.

727.abstract: As the battle for Mygeeto rages, Caleb Dume's secret communications with the Separatist General Kleeve put him at odds with his own commanders and his master, Depa Billaba.

728.abstract: The siege of Mygeeto reaches a turning point as Caleb Dume's actions have unforeseen consequences for both the Republic and Separatist forces. Master Billaba must confront the darkness growing within the war.

729.abstract: The Mygeeto campaign concludes, leaving deep scars on Padawan Caleb Dume. The hard-won victory does little to quell his doubts about the war, setting the stage for the even greater trials that await him.

730.abstract: An unknown enemy attacks the Chiss Ascendancy, forcing the brilliant officer Mitth'raw'nuruodo to choose between the rules of his people and the safety of their worlds.

731.abstract: The premature execution of a Jedi by clone trooper Tup leads ARC Trooper Fives to uncover a horrific secret conspiracy at the heart of the clone army.

735.abstract: Padmé Amidala travels to the Banking Clan's homeworld of Scipio to investigate corruption, only to find herself entangled in a Separatist plot involving her old flame, Rush Clovis.

738.abstract: Jar Jar Binks and Mace Windu must rescue the kidnapped Queen of Bardotta from a mysterious cult seeking to drain her of her living Force energy.

739.abstract: Jar Jar Binks and Mace Windu must rescue the kidnapped Queen of Bardotta from a mysterious cult seeking to drain her of her living Force energy.

740.abstract: The Jedi Council uncovers a hidden message from the late Master Sifo-Dyas, leading Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker on a trail to the Pyke Syndicate to uncover the truth about the creation of the clone army.

741.abstract: Hired for a mission on Pantora, former Sith assassin Asajj Ventress crosses paths with the roguish Jedi Master Quinlan Vos, leading to an unexpected and volatile partnership.

742.abstract: Guided by the voice of the late Qui-Gon Jinn, Master Yoda embarks on a solitary journey across the galaxy to learn the secrets of the Force and the path to life after death.

745.abstract: Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker investigate the death of a Jedi Master on Utapau, uncovering a Separatist plot to acquire a massive kyber crystal.

749.abstract: Senator Padmé Amidala and Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker undertake a diplomatic mission to Vondarc, where they must navigate political intrigue and a deadly local beast.

750.abstract: The Jedi Council makes a desperate decision to assassinate Count Dooku, tasking the unorthodox Master Quinlan Vos to team up with the infamous dark side user Asajj Ventress.

751.abstract: After being captured by Darth Sidious, Maul is rescued by his Mandalorian allies and seeks to rebuild his criminal empire, drawing the attention of both the Jedi and the Sith.

755.abstract: On a solo diplomatic mission behind enemy lines, Senator Padmé Amidala attempts to convince a neutral world to reject the Separatists, relying solely on her wits and words.

756.abstract: After leaving the Jedi Order, Ahsoka Tano finds herself in the Coruscant underworld, where she befriends the Martez sisters and gets drawn into a dangerous job for the Pyke Syndicate.

760.abstract: Captain Rex and the Bad Batch, a squad of elite, genetically-enhanced clones, launch a daring mission to uncover how the Separatists are predicting the Republic's every move.

761.abstract: A comic retelling of Clone Force 99's mission with Captain Rex to Anaxes, where they uncover a Separatist plot using a captured Republic soldier.

762.abstract: Captain Rex and the Bad Batch, a squad of elite, genetically-enhanced clones, launch a daring rescue mission to retrieve the clone strategist Echo from the Separatists on Skako Minor.

765.abstract: Emerging scoundrel Kay Vess and her companion Nix navigate the criminal underworld, pulling off heists and making a name for themselves across the Outer Rim.

766.abstract: Ahsoka Tano and Captain Rex lead the 501st Legion alongside Bo-Katan Kryze's forces in a massive assault to liberate Mandalore from the control of Maul and his Shadow Collective.

767.abstract: A comic adaptation of the climactic duel between Ahsoka Tano and Maul in the throne room of Sundari during the final hours of the Clone Wars.

768.abstract: As the Clone Wars rage, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker is seduced by the dark side of the Force, leading to the fall of the Republic and the rise of the Galactic Empire.

769.abstract: An expanded telling of the final days of the Clone Wars, detailing Anakin Skywalker's tragic fall to darkness and the Jedi Order's destruction at the hands of Darth Sidious.

770.abstract: As the Clone Wars near their end, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker is seduced by the dark side of the Force, leading to the fall of the Jedi Order and the rise of the Galactic Empire.

773.abstract: Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and Master Obi-Wan Kenobi embark on one final mission together to rescue a group of brilliant scientists from Separatist forces.

774.abstract: At the height of the Battle of Coruscant, Jedi Knights Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi face Count Dooku aboard the Separatist flagship in a fateful duel.

775.abstract: On the volcanic world of Mustafar, former friends Obi-Wan Kenobi and the newly christened Darth Vader engage in a tragic and devastating lightsaber duel that will shape the fate of the galaxy.

776.abstract: Ahsoka Tano confronts Maul during the Siege of Mandalore, learning of his dark premonitions about Darth Sidious's plan to destroy the Jedi. Their duel will decide the fate of the planet.

777.abstract: While transporting the captured Maul, Ahsoka Tano and Captain Rex are betrayed when Order 66 is executed, forcing them to fight for their lives against their own clone troopers.

778.abstract: Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi travels to the sinkhole world of Utapau to confront the cyborg commander General Grievous and end the Clone Wars.

779.abstract: Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi travels to the sinkhole world of Utapau to confront the cyborg commander General Grievous and end the Clone Wars.

780.abstract: Tormented by visions of his wife's death, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker makes a desperate pact with Chancellor Palpatine, embracing the dark side to gain the power he believes can save her.

781.abstract: With the Jedi Order destroyed and his apprentice Darth Vader at his side, Emperor Palpatine solidifies his control over the galaxy, transforming the Republic into the first Galactic Empire.

782.abstract: Clone Force 99 witnesses the execution of Order 66 on Kaller and its aftermath on Kamino, forcing them to question their loyalty to the newly formed Galactic Empire.

783.abstract: The elite clone commandos of Clone Force 99 find themselves on the run from the new Galactic Empire after defying Order 66, taking on mercenary missions to survive in a rapidly changing galaxy.

784.abstract: Following the execution of Order 66 and the death of his master, Padawan Caleb Dume is forced to flee from his former clone comrades, beginning his life as a fugitive from the Empire.

785.abstract: On the run from Imperial forces, young Caleb Dume finds an unlikely ally in the smuggler Janus Kasmir, who teaches him the first lessons of survival in a galaxy that now hunts Jedi.

786.abstract: Ahsoka Tano and Captain Rex must escape their crashing Star Destroyer while evading both the brainwashed clone troopers and the rampaging Maul.

787.abstract: A big-game hunter travels to the dangerous world of Numidian Prime, seeking to capture a legendary creature known as the Leviathan for a wealthy client.

788.abstract: In the heart of the Galactic Senate, Jedi Grand Master Yoda confronts the Sith Lord Darth Sidious in an epic battle for the future of the galaxy.

789.abstract: Following his defeat on Mustafar, the horribly burned Anakin Skywalker is rebuilt into the cyborg Darth Vader, fully embracing his new identity as a Dark Lord of the Sith.

790.abstract: Immediately after his transformation, Darth Vader is tested by Emperor Palpatine and begins his quest to forge a Sith lightsaber by hunting a Jedi survivor.

791.abstract: The life of Leia Organa is chronicled, from her upbringing as a princess on Alderaan to her leadership as a general in the fight for galactic freedom.

792.abstract: Former Jedi Padawan Barriss Offee is recruited from her prison cell into the nascent Inquisitorius program, where she must prove her devotion to the dark side.

793.abstract: Following the fall of the Jedi Order, a grieving Ahsoka Tano attends the funeral of her friend Padmé Amidala from afar, resolving to stay hidden from the new Empire.

794.abstract: Darth Vader tracks the Jedi Master Kirak Infil'a to the river moon of Al'doleem, seeking to claim the Jedi's kyber crystal for his own weapon.

795.abstract: Disarmed and facing the formidable Jedi Master Kirak Infil'a, Darth Vader must use his raw power and cunning to survive and continue his dark quest.

796.abstract: Having defeated his Jedi prey, Darth Vader travels to the fiery world of Mustafar to bleed the captured kyber crystal, bending it to the will of the dark side.

797.abstract: Wielding his newly forged crimson lightsaber, Darth Vader returns to Coruscant and faces the Emperor's Inquisitorius program, asserting his dominance as the Dark Lord of the Sith.

798.abstract: The newly anointed Darth Vader must prove his worth to the Emperor by hunting down a Jedi survivor and forging his own red-bladed lightsaber.

799.abstract: A Jedi Knight is tasked with tracking down and confronting the dreaded Separatist commander, General Grievous, to bring an end to the Clone Wars.

800.abstract: Darth Vader is dispatched to hunt down Jedi Master Jocasta Nu, the former Chief Librarian of the Jedi Archives, who seeks to preserve the Order's forbidden knowledge.

801.abstract: The Bad Batch seeks refuge with clone deserter Cut Lawquane and his family, forcing them to confront the reality of their new lives as fugitives from the Empire.

802.abstract: While stranded on a desolate moon, the Bad Batch must repair their ship, as Crosshair is put in command of a new squad of elite Imperial recruits.

803.abstract: While attempting to resupply on Pantora, the Bad Batch is pursued by the bounty hunter Fennec Shand, who has been hired to retrieve Omega.

804.abstract: The Bad Batch takes on a mission from the Trandoshan informant Cid to rescue a child from Zygerrian slavers, only to discover their target is a juvenile rancor.

805.abstract: On a mission from Cid to a decommissioning facility on Corellia, the Bad Batch encounters the Martez sisters, who are also after the same tactical droid head.

806.abstract: Darth Vader continues his hunt for Jedi Master Jocasta Nu, who has returned to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant to retrieve a secret list of Force-sensitive children.

807.abstract: In the ruins of the Jedi Temple, Darth Vader confronts Jocasta Nu, battling the archivist for control of the Jedi's most precious secrets.

808.abstract: The Grand Inquisitor and his forces corner Jocasta Nu, but Darth Vader intervenes, determined to claim the Jedi's knowledge for himself and his Master.

809.abstract: Darth Vader secures the list of Force-sensitive children from Jocasta Nu, further solidifying his role as the Emperor's enforcer and the scourge of the remaining Jedi.

810.abstract: A young Force-sensitive boy on an isolated world receives a terrifying lesson from Darth Vader about the true nature of the dark side.

811.abstract: In the aftermath of Order 66, Darth Vader and the Inquisitorius hunt surviving Jedi on the water world of Mon Cala, facing unexpected resistance from the planet's king.

812.abstract: Darth Vader personally confronts the Jedi Master Ferren Barr and his acolytes, crushing the nascent Mon Calamari rebellion with overwhelming force.

813.abstract: Clone Force 99 reunites with Captain Rex, who helps them undertake a dangerous procedure on the junkyard world of Bracca to remove their inhibitor chips.

814.abstract: While scavenging on Bracca, the Bad Batch is ambushed by their former squadmate Crosshair and must also contend with the notorious bounty hunter Cad Bane.

815.abstract: After being captured by Cad Bane, Omega must use her wits to escape an abandoned Kaminoan facility with the help of the droid Todo 360.

816.abstract: Seeking to lay low, the Bad Batch takes a job on the planet Hisseen, only to find themselves caught between a greedy baron and the local populace.

817.abstract: On a mission for Cid, the Bad Batch travels to the former Separatist capital of Raxus to extract a senator targeted by the new Galactic Empire.

818.abstract: The rise of the Empire is felt on Ryloth, as a young Hera Syndulla and her family witness the tightening grip of Imperial control on their homeworld.

819.abstract: Clone Force 99 returns to Ryloth at the request of Hera Syndulla to rescue her parents, Cham and Eleni, from the clutches of Admiral Rampart.

820.abstract: The Bad Batch must clear out a dangerous nest of creatures from an old mine on Ord Mantell to help Cid reclaim her cantina from a rival.

821.abstract: An Imperial officer stationed on the mining world of Gorse confronts a local legend, discovering that fear can be a powerful tool of control.

822.abstract: Following a tip from Captain Rex, the Bad Batch infiltrates a secret Imperial training facility on Daro to rescue the commando clone Gregor.

823.abstract: To rescue a captured Hunter, the rest of the Bad Batch must return to their former home, the cloning facilities of Tipoca City on Kamino.

824.abstract: Caught in the Imperial bombardment of Tipoca City, the Bad Batch must navigate the sinking ruins of their home to escape with their lives.

825.abstract: Clone Force 99 travels to Serenno to plunder the late Count Dooku's war chest, hoping to secure their financial freedom from the Empire.

826.abstract: After securing a portion of Dooku's treasure, the Bad Batch must fight their way off Serenno as Imperial forces close in on them.

827.abstract: Stationed on the desolate world of Desix, Crosshair is forced to question his loyalty to the Empire when his commanding officer abandons their clone troops.

828.abstract: While on a supply run, Tech, Wrecker, and Omega get involved in the dangerous and high-stakes world of riot racing on Safa Toma.

829.abstract: Following a treasure map, the Bad Batch uncovers an ancient and powerful weapon within a forgotten tomb on the desert moon of Kaldar Trinary.

830.abstract: The Bad Batch encounters a Wookiee Jedi youngling named Gungi and undertakes a perilous mission to return him to his people on Kashyyyk.

831.abstract: On Coruscant, Senator Riyo Chuchi investigates the truth behind the destruction of Kamino, uncovering a conspiracy at the highest levels of the Empire.

832.abstract: With the help of the Bad Batch, Senator Chuchi presents evidence of Admiral Rampart's treachery to the Imperial Senate, leading to unforeseen consequences for all clones.

836.abstract: While on a mining mission, the Bad Batch has their ship stolen, leaving them stranded on a desolate world with dwindling supplies.

837.abstract: The squad tracks their stolen ship to a hazardous mining operation, where they discover the miners are being exploited and must inspire a revolt to get their property back.

838.abstract: The Bad Batch discovers a secret Imperial science vessel and learns of Dr. Hemlock's horrific experiments involving a Zillo Beast clone.

839.abstract: Crosshair's faith in the Empire is shattered when he witnesses the cold-blooded execution of a fellow clone officer on the remote outpost of Barton-4.

840.abstract: Seeking a safe haven, the Bad Batch is introduced to the idyllic planet of Pabu, a refuge for those displaced by the Empire.

842.abstract: After receiving a desperate message from Echo, the Bad Batch learns that Dr. Hemlock is targeting them and other clones for his experiments.

843.abstract: The Bad Batch travels to an Imperial summit on Eriadu, hoping to place a tracking device on Dr. Hemlock's ship to locate his secret facility.

844.abstract: When their mission on Eriadu goes awry, the squad is forced into a desperate escape that results in a tragic sacrifice to save the others.

845.abstract: Imprisoned within the Mount Tantiss facility, Omega and Crosshair endure Dr. Hemlock's experiments while secretly planning their escape.

846.abstract: Hunter and Wrecker follow a lead to an abandoned cloning facility on Setron, searching for any information that could lead them to Omega.

847.abstract: Omega and Crosshair make a daring attempt to escape the high-security Imperial facility on Mount Tantiss, putting their trust in one another.

848.abstract: Hunter and Wrecker track down a former Imperial officer on Devaron, hoping to extract information about the location of Mount Tantiss.

849.abstract: Reunited with Echo, the Bad Batch returns to the ship-breaking yards of Bracca to retrieve vital intelligence from a wrecked Venator-class Star Destroyer.

850.abstract: Captain Rex's clone commandos infiltrate an Imperial base on Teth to rescue a comrade, discovering the Empire is hunting a mysterious child. The Bad Batch arrives to provide unexpected, and initially unwanted, assistance in the ensuing firefight.

851.abstract: The Bad Batch and Rex's forces must fight their way out of the Imperial base on Teth with their rescued clone and Omega. The escape is complicated by the arrival of Commander Wolffe, forcing a tense confrontation between old comrades.

852.abstract: Hunter and Wrecker take on a bounty hunting mission to gather intel on M-count targets, leading them into a dangerous jungle. They find themselves in a reluctant partnership with the deadly assassin Fennec Shand to survive and complete their objective.

853.abstract: The former Sith assassin Asajj Ventress arrives on Pabu, seeking out Omega at the behest of Quinlan Vos. She tests Omega's connection to the Force, revealing unsettling truths and raising more questions about the Empire's interest in the child.

854.abstract: Within the secret Imperial facility on Mount Tantiss, Dr. Emerie Karr grows conflicted about her work on Project Necromancer. Elsewhere, a disillusioned Imperial scientist leaks vital information about the project to former Admiral Rampart.

855.abstract: An Imperial Star Destroyer arrives in orbit over Pabu, deploying forces to locate Omega. The Bad Batch and the island's residents must scramble to evacuate before the Empire closes its net, leading to a desperate standoff and Omega's capture.

856.abstract: To find the location of Mount Tantiss, the Bad Batch must infiltrate a high-security Imperial labor camp on Erebus. Their mission is to extract former Admiral Rampart, the one person who may hold the key to rescuing Omega.

857.abstract: The Bad Batch, guided by Rampart, arrives at the secret Imperial facility on Mount Tantiss to begin their infiltration. Inside the base, Omega and the other captive children begin to formulate their own escape plan with the help of Dr. Emerie Karr.

858.abstract: The assault on Mount Tantiss begins as the Bad Batch fights their way into the facility, aided by the arrival of Echo. Inside, Omega and the other children unleash a Zillo Beast as a diversion, causing chaos throughout the Imperial base.

859.abstract: In the final confrontation at Mount Tantiss, the Bad Batch fights to rescue the captive children and destroy Project Necromancer once and for all. The clones must make their final stand against Dr. Hemlock and his forces, determining the fate of their family.

860.abstract: An in-universe fable about a brave knight who confronts a fearsome krayt dragon. Through courage and understanding, she discovers the dragon is a mother protecting her young and brokers peace instead of war.

861.abstract: An in-universe horror story about a cruel headmistress at a remote orphanage. Her attempts to exploit a Force-sensitive child awaken a terrifying, shadowy entity that protects the innocent and punishes the wicked.

862.abstract: A cautionary tale told to young Wookiees about the Dark Wraith, a fearsome creature that hunts those who stray from the path of honor. The story emphasizes the importance of family, courage, and upholding the Wookiee code.

863.abstract: Aboard the Starlight Beacon, a Jedi Knight reflects on the legacy of their former master. They contemplate the weight of the past and the path they must forge for themselves in the service of the Order.

864.abstract: Smugglers operating on the Imperial-occupied world of Jedha find their ship impounded. They must navigate the treacherous streets and avoid Imperial patrols to recover their vessel and escape the holy moon.

865.abstract: On the run after Order 66, the young Padawan Caleb Dume struggles to survive on the planet Kaller. He falls in with the smuggler Janus Kasmir, learning the harsh realities of a galaxy now ruled by the Empire.

866.abstract: Caleb Dume's past catches up to him when his former clone comrades, Commander Grey and Captain Styles, track him to Kaller. A tense confrontation forces Caleb to fully embrace his new identity to escape the Empire's grasp.

867.abstract: Darth Vader arrives on Mon Cala to crush the planet's nascent rebellion, only to find the Jedi archivist Jocasta Nu has preceded him. The Dark Lord begins his hunt for the Jedi, who seeks to preserve the Order's most vital secrets from the Empire.

868.abstract: As the Imperial invasion of Mon Cala rages, Darth Vader continues his relentless pursuit of Jocasta Nu. The Jedi Master uses her knowledge of a hidden Jedi outpost to evade the Sith Lord and his forces.

869.abstract: The hunt for Jocasta Nu intensifies as Darth Vader corners her within the ancient Jedi outpost on Mon Cala. Meanwhile, the Mon Calamari resistance fights a desperate battle against the overwhelming Imperial fleet.

870.abstract: Darth Vader finally confronts Jocasta Nu, who reveals she has a list of Force-sensitive children that could rebuild the Jedi Order. The duel is interrupted by the Grand Inquisitor, giving the Jedi Master a chance to escape.

871.abstract: Having escaped Mon Cala, Jocasta Nu returns to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant on a desperate mission to retrieve a vital holocron. Darth Vader pursues her into the heart of the ruined Temple for their final, fateful confrontation.

872.abstract: Darth Vader travels to a remote lava world to bleed a kyber crystal for a new lightsaber, a ritual that pits him against the crystal's light-side will. The dark side ritual is interrupted by a Jedi survivor, forcing Vader to prove his mastery over both the light and his past.

873.abstract: On a remote Outer Rim world, the droids R2-D2 and C-3PO attempt to help a village fend off local bandits. Their well-intentioned efforts lead to a series of comical mishaps and unintended consequences.

874.abstract: Hiding from the Empire after the fall of the Jedi, Ahsoka Tano tries to build a new life on the remote moon of Raada. When the Empire's oppression arrives, she is forced to reveal herself to protect the innocent, taking her first steps toward becoming a leader in the nascent rebellion.

875.abstract: Senior Captain Thrawn of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet uncovers a mysterious enemy sowing discord among the ruling families of the Chiss Ascendancy. He must navigate political intrigue and hidden threats to expose the conspiracy before it tears his people apart from within.

876.abstract: When their parents are captured by the Galactic Empire, siblings Milo and Lina Graf must escape their home on Dantooine with their droid CR-8R. Their journey to find their parents and join the Rebellion begins.

877.abstract: Continuing their search for their parents, Milo and Lina Graf follow a lead into the treacherous territory of Wild Space. They soon find themselves caught in a trap set by the ruthless Imperial Captain Korda.

878.abstract: The Graf siblings' journey leads them to the planet Ifrane, a world covered in abandoned, hostile droid factories. They must navigate the dangerous 'nest' to find a component needed to track their parents' location.

879.abstract: Milo and Lina Graf travel to the Imperial-controlled world of Lothal to steal a data tape that could reveal their parents' whereabouts. Their heist puts them in direct conflict with the local Imperial garrison.

880.abstract: Shipwrecked in a dangerous asteroid field, Milo and Lina Graf must survive in the dark while evading space pirates. They discover they are not alone in the wreckage, finding a mysterious and potentially dangerous survivor.

881.abstract: Following a clue, the Graf siblings land on the frozen planet of Thune. They must brave the extreme cold and hostile wildlife to uncover the next piece of the puzzle in the search for their parents.

882.abstract: Having finally located their parents at a secret Imperial prison, Milo and Lina Graf must stage a daring rescue mission. They risk everything to infiltrate the high-security facility and free their family from the clutches of Captain Korda.

883.abstract: As the mysterious Jixtus launches his final, devastating attack against the Chiss Ascendancy, Senior Captain Thrawn must make an impossible choice. To save his people, he may have to sacrifice his own career, honor, and place within the Ascendancy itself.

884.abstract: Now serving as the Magistrate of a small village on Corvus, Morgan Elsbeth is confronted by the harsh reality of the growing New Republic. A confrontation with a New Republic official forces her to take drastic measures to protect her people and her vision for the future.

885.abstract: Aboard the Millennium Falcon, a small maintenance droid learns about the meaning of Life Day from its fellow droids. It discovers that the spirit of the holiday is about togetherness and caring for one's family and friends.

893.abstract: On a peaceful day on Naboo, Senator Padmé Amidala gives Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker a tour of her humanitarian work, revealing a side of her life beyond the galactic senate and war.

894.abstract: An exiled Chiss officer with unparalleled tactical genius is discovered by the Empire, beginning a meteoric rise through the Imperial Navy that challenges the prejudices and politics of his human superiors.

895.abstract: The brilliant Chiss strategist Mitth'raw'nuruodo begins his ascent within the Imperial Navy, demonstrating his unique methods of understanding and defeating his enemies.

901.abstract: When their shuttle is shot down over Ryloth, Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader must survive in the hostile wilderness while being hunted by Cham Syndulla's Free Ryloth movement.

902.abstract: In the early days of the Empire, Emperor Palpatine gives a tour of his new office to his closest advisors, using the opportunity to impart a lesson on the nature of power and the dark side.

903.abstract: Governor Wilhuff Tarkin relentlessly pursues a band of dissidents who have stolen his personal starship, a hunt that forces him to confront his past and solidifies his ruthless reputation within the Empire.

904.abstract: Aboard the first Death Star, stormtrooper TK-462 experiences a crisis of conscience after witnessing the destructive power of the battle station, causing him to question his loyalty to the Empire.

905.abstract: Darth Vader and Governor Tarkin lead the brutal Imperial subjugation of Mon Cala, seeking to crush the planet's defiant king and secure its valuable shipyards for the Empire.

910.abstract: Cal Kestis, a Jedi Padawan hiding from the Empire after Order 66, is drawn into a quest to find a Jedi Holocron and potentially rebuild the Jedi Order, all while being hunted by the deadly Inquisitorius.

912.abstract: Years before the fall of the Republic, Jedi Master Eno Cordova and his Padawan Cere Junda are sent to the planet Ontotho to oversee an excavation, only to become entangled in a violent local conflict.

917.abstract: The notorious Lepi smuggler Jaxxon T. Tumperakki takes on a seemingly simple job to find a lost pet aboard a space station, which quickly escalates into a chaotic adventure.

918.abstract: On a routine smuggling run, Han Solo and Chewbacca find themselves in hot water after a deal goes sour, forcing them to make a daring escape from local enforcers.

919.abstract: During the High Republic era, a Jedi Knight investigates a mysterious, silent song emanating from a sacred mountain on a remote winter world, uncovering a deep connection to the Force.

920.abstract: A young Hera Syndulla undertakes a dangerous mission on her Imperial-occupied homeworld, delivering vital supplies and demonstrating the courage that will one day make her a general.

921.abstract: On the industrial streets of Corellia, teenage scrumrats Han and Qi'ra navigate the treacherous criminal underworld, forging a deep bond as they plot their escape from the clutches of the White Worms gang.

922.abstract: Expelled from the flight academy, Han Solo struggles to adapt to the rigid life of an Imperial infantry cadet on Carida, constantly clashing with authority and dreaming of a life among the stars.

923.abstract: After being forcibly separated from Han Solo, Qi'ra is sold to the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn, where she must use her intelligence and ruthlessness to survive and climb its treacherous ranks.

928.abstract: After being abandoned by partisan leader Saw Gerrera, a teenage Jyn Erso must learn to survive on her own in a galaxy under Imperial rule, honing the skills that will eventually lead her to the Rebel Alliance.

929.abstract: The crew of the Stinger Mantis is pulled into a dangerous mission by a stormtrooper defector, forcing Cal Kestis and his companions to confront new threats and the personal toll of their fight against the Empire.

930.abstract: On the volcanic world of Mustafar, Darth Vader oversees the construction of his personal fortress, a grim monument designed to channel the dark side and grant him access to secrets beyond death.

931.abstract: Darth Vader confronts the spirit of the ancient Sith Lord Momin, who has possessed a new body and seeks to use the power of Vader's fortress on Mustafar for his own dark designs.

932.abstract: In the final battle for his Mustafar fortress, Darth Vader duels the resurrected Sith Lord Momin, ultimately destroying him and claiming the dark side nexus as his own.

933.abstract: An Imperial Inquisitor relentlessly hunts a surviving Jedi across the galaxy, employing fear and the dark side to extinguish the last remnants of the old Order.

938.abstract: The bounty hunter Jas Emari is hired by Hondo Ohnaka to retrieve a datarod, but the mission becomes complicated when the droid IG-88 is also sent after the same prize.

939.abstract: Smuggler Lando Calrissian and his droid L3-37 take on a dangerous job to deliver weapons to freedom fighters on the Imperial-controlled world of Hynestia, relying on their wits and luck to succeed.

940.abstract: Grand Moff Tarkin and Commander Rae Sloane are dispatched to Ryloth to quell a Twi'lek insurgency, employing ruthless tactics to crush the rebellion and secure Imperial control.

941.abstract: On the Outer Rim mining world of Gorse, a cynical former Jedi Padawan, Kanan Jarrus, crosses paths with the driven revolutionary Hera Syndulla, forcing him to decide whether to remain in hiding or fight back against the Empire.

942.abstract: The infamous pirate Hondo Ohnaka recounts a tale of one of his many "acquisitions" to a new recruit at Maz Kanata's castle, embellishing the story for maximum effect.

943.abstract: The scoundrel Tobias Beckett and his crew, Val and Rio Durant, take on a perilous job for the infamous Enfys Nest, infiltrating a high-security facility to steal valuable unrefined coaxium.

944.abstract: A young Han Solo escapes his life of servitude on Corellia, joining a gang of smugglers led by Tobias Beckett to pull off a series of daring heists that will set him on the path to becoming the galaxy's most famous scoundrel.

957.abstract: Serving as an Imperial mudtrooper on Mimban, Han Solo meets a Wookiee prisoner named Chewbacca and a group of criminals led by Tobias Beckett, seizing an opportunity to desert and join them.

958.abstract: The story of the unbreakable bond between the smuggler Han Solo and the mighty Wookiee Chewbacca is chronicled, from their first meeting to their heroic deeds with the Rebel Alliance.

959.abstract: A young Han Solo and his new crew attempt a daring heist of a speeding Imperial conveyex transport on the snowy planet of Vandor.

960.abstract: Han Solo and Tobias Beckett's crew attempt a high-stakes heist of a shipment of coaxium from an Imperial conveyex train on the snowy world of Vandor.

961.abstract: In need of a fast ship, Han Solo and Qi'ra track down the charming gambler Lando Calrissian and his Millennium Falcon to win it in a game of sabacc.

962.abstract: Han Solo pilots the Millennium Falcon on the infamous Kessel Run, navigating a treacherous maelstrom to deliver a volatile shipment of stolen coaxium for the crime lord Dryden Vos.

963.abstract: The strength and loyalty of the Wookiee warrior Chewbacca are showcased through his fierce battles against Imperial forces and his unwavering defense of his friends.

964.abstract: On the desert planet Savareen, Han Solo's crew refines the stolen coaxium while facing a confrontation with Enfys Nest and the Cloud-Riders, revealing unexpected allegiances.

965.abstract: In a final showdown aboard Dryden Vos's yacht, Han and Qi'ra confront the ruthless leader of Crimson Dawn, leading to betrayals that will shape their destinies forever.

966.abstract: The journey of Han Solo is traced from a cynical, self-serving smuggler to a courageous leader and General in the Rebel Alliance, fighting for freedom across the galaxy.

967.abstract: An agent of the New Republic's "Phantom Squadron" undertakes missions across the galaxy, uncovering a secret Imperial plot that threatens the fragile peace.

968.abstract: An agent of the New Republic's "Phantom Squadron" undertakes missions across the galaxy, uncovering a secret Imperial plot that threatens the fragile peace.

969.abstract: A former member of the Shadow Collective and a Crimson Dawn loyalist meet on Dathomir, where they confront the lingering legacy of their former master, Maul.

970.abstract: On the planet Obredaan, the antiquarian Antron Bach discovers a Jedi artifact from the High Republic era, forcing him to confront the Empire's efforts to erase the history of the Jedi Order.

971.abstract: A mighty Wookiee warrior, enslaved by the Empire, finds an unlikely ally in a brash young smuggler, beginning a lifelong partnership forged in the fires of rebellion and adventure.

972.abstract: Following the devastation of her people during the Clone Wars, a Nightsister survivor channels her grief into a path of power, aligning herself with the growing Galactic Empire to build a new future.

973.abstract: A broken Jedi Master, living in exile on a desolate desert world, is haunted by his past while watching over a young boy who represents the galaxy's only hope. His quiet life is shattered when Imperial Inquisitors arrive, hunting for Jedi survivors.

974.abstract: In the desolate sands of Tatooine, a Jedi in hiding watches over the last hope for the galaxy, grappling with the ghosts of his past as the shadow of the Empire and its Jedi hunters draws near.

975.abstract: Lured from his exile to rescue a kidnapped princess, Obi-Wan Kenobi travels to the neon-drenched underworld of Daiyu, where he must navigate a city of spies and bounty hunters while confronting a painful truth about his fallen apprentice.

976.abstract: The exiled Jedi Master's quest to save a young princess leads him to the crime-ridden streets of Daiyu, forcing him to reconnect with the Force and face the relentless pursuit of the Imperial Inquisitors.

977.abstract: Stranded on a desolate mining planet, Obi-Wan and the young princess seek aid from the underground network known as the Path, but their escape is cut short by a terrifying confrontation with Darth Vader himself.

978.abstract: On the run in the desolate landscape of Mapuzo, Obi-Wan Kenobi faces his past in the most brutal way possible when he is confronted by his former apprentice, the fearsome Darth Vader.

979.abstract: To rescue Princess Leia from the clutches of the Inquisitors, Obi-Wan Kenobi must infiltrate their heavily fortified underwater headquarters, the Fortress Inquisitorius on the moon of Nur.

980.abstract: A desperate rescue mission takes Obi-Wan Kenobi into the heart of the Empire's power, the dreaded Fortress Inquisitorius, to save Princess Leia from interrogation and certain doom.

981.abstract: The Path's hidden base on Jabiim comes under siege by Imperial forces led by Darth Vader, forcing Obi-Wan to hold the line and protect the Force-sensitive refugees while a dark truth about an Inquisitor is revealed.

982.abstract: Trapped and besieged within a hidden sanctuary on Jabiim, Obi-Wan Kenobi must rally the defenders of the Path against the overwhelming might of Darth Vader and his Imperial legions.

983.abstract: Obi-Wan Kenobi confronts Darth Vader in a final, devastating duel to protect the future of the galaxy, while on Tatooine, a vengeful Inquisitor hunts for the young Luke Skywalker.

984.abstract: The final, epic confrontation between master and apprentice unfolds, as Obi-Wan Kenobi faces Darth Vader in a battle that will define their legacies, while the fate of Luke Skywalker hangs in the balance on Tatooine.

985.abstract: Jedi Knight Cal Kestis continues his fight against the Empire, seeking a hidden sanctuary for those persecuted by the dark side, but uncovers an ancient threat from the High Republic era.

986.abstract: Jedi Master Yoda and a group of younglings find themselves stranded on a remote world, where they must rely on the Force and each other to survive a dangerous predator.

987.abstract: On a mission to a remote trading outpost, droids R2-D2 and C-3PO are separated from their masters and must navigate the dangers of the wilderness and local fauna to reunite.

988.abstract: With the help of a Lepi smuggler, R2-D2 and C-3PO evade local threats and Imperial patrols in a desperate attempt to find Luke Skywalker and Princess Leia.

990.abstract: From the journals of Obi-Wan Kenobi, a tale of his exile on Tatooine unfolds as he protects a young Luke Skywalker from Jabba the Hutt's thugs, struggling to maintain his Jedi principles in a lawless land.

991.abstract: An Imperial art critic is tasked with reviewing a new sculpture commissioned by Emperor Palpatine, only to find the experience to be a terrifying test of loyalty and perception.

992.abstract: Continuing his vigil over Luke Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi is forced to confront the deadly Wookiee bounty hunter Black Krrsantan, who has been hired by Jabba the Hutt to terrorize Owen Lars.

993.abstract: Obi-Wan Kenobi faces a new challenge when a formidable Tusken war party, led by a skilled warrior, threatens the moisture farmers, forcing the hidden Jedi to intervene once more to protect the Skywalker homestead.

995.abstract: Hired by Jabba the Hutt for a high-stakes heist, smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca find themselves entangled with a mysterious figure from Han's past and a ruthless bounty hunter, turning a simple job into a deadly chase.
