1016.abstract: A young, aspiring pilot gets a chance to participate in the dangerous sport of podracing in the deserts of Tatooine, facing down rivals and treacherous terrain to claim victory.

1017.abstract: A young farmboy on a desolate desert planet discovers a fateful message hidden within a droid, setting him on a path that will change the galaxy forever.

1018.abstract: Two childhood friends from the Outer Rim join the Imperial Academy, but their loyalties are tested as one becomes a devoted officer and the other a pilot for the Rebel Alliance, their intertwined destinies playing out against the backdrop of the Galactic Civil War.

1019.abstract: The epic story of two star-crossed lovers on opposite sides of the Galactic Civil War, from their shared dreams at the Imperial Academy to their fateful encounters in the battles that shaped the galaxy.

1020.abstract: A guide for adventurers navigating the treacherous Outer Rim during the height of the Galactic Empire's power, detailing shadowy organizations, forgotten worlds, and the ever-present threat of Imperial domination.

1024.abstract: An Imperial cadet on Lothal, Zare Leonis, secretly investigates the disappearance of his sister while navigating the treacherous environment of the Arkanis Academy.

1025.abstract: The infamous pirate Hondo Ohnaka recounts a tale of a clever deal he made with the Empire, acquiring a shipment of blasters through his signature cunning and charm.

1026.abstract: While establishing a new base, Princess Leia Organa and her droids encounter the native Hoojibs, a species of telepathic, energy-consuming creatures.

1027.abstract: The assassin droid IG-88 is hired by the Empire to retrieve a vital decoder from a Rebel courier, a mission he carries out with ruthless efficiency.

1028.abstract: While searching for his sister on the corporate-controlled world of Morlana One, Cassian Andor's past catches up to him after a violent altercation, drawing the attention of a determined deputy inspector.

1029.abstract: As Deputy Inspector Syril Karn closes in, Cassian returns to his adopted home of Ferrix to plan his escape, where he encounters a mysterious buyer named Luthen Rael.

1030.abstract: Cornered by corporate security forces, Cassian Andor must fight his way out with the unexpected help of Luthen Rael, forcing him to leave his home behind and join a greater cause.

1031.abstract: Luthen Rael recruits a reluctant Cassian for a high-stakes heist against an Imperial garrison on Aldhani, where he must integrate with a small, tense group of local rebels.

1032.abstract: Tensions rise within the Aldhani rebel cell as they finalize their plan to attack the Imperial garrison, forcing Cassian to work to earn the trust of his new, wary comrades.

1033.abstract: Under the cover of a spectacular celestial event, the rebel team infiltrates the Imperial garrison to steal the quarterly payroll in a daring raid that ends with unforeseen casualties.

1034.abstract: In the aftermath of the Aldhani heist, the Empire cracks down with draconian new laws, while a vacationing Cassian Andor is wrongfully arrested on the resort planet of Niamos.

1035.abstract: Transported to a brutal Imperial prison factory on the water world of Narkina 5, Cassian must quickly learn the rules of survival from his floor manager, the hardened inmate Kino Loy.

1036.abstract: As conditions in the Narkina 5 prison worsen and rumors of inescapable sentences spread, Cassian and Kino Loy begin to secretly plan a mass escape.

1037.abstract: With an entire level of the prison executed, Kino Loy is finally convinced to act, delivering a rousing speech that ignites a full-scale prison break against their Imperial captors.

1038.abstract: Following his escape, Cassian learns of his adoptive mother Maarva's death and decides to return to Ferrix for her funeral, despite the immense risk of capture by the Empire.

1039.abstract: The Empire attempts to use Maarva's funeral to lure Cassian Andor into a trap, but her final recorded message instead incites a full-blown riot against the Imperial occupation.

1040.abstract: On the streets of Lothal, the young orphan Ezra Bridger crosses paths with the notorious Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk, forming an uneasy alliance for a dangerous job.

1041.abstract: The crew of the Ghost undertakes a mission to raid an Imperial supply depot on Lothal, liberating valuable resources for the fledgling rebellion.

1042.abstract: The Spectres, a small rebel cell, execute a daring plan to steal Imperial fuel containers in the Lothal sector, a mission saved by their temperamental astromech, Chopper.

1043.abstract: When a mission to acquire Imperial fuel goes wrong, the Ghost's grumpy astromech Chopper must step up to outsmart the Empire and save his crewmates.

1044.abstract: The rebel crew of the Ghost stages a raid on an Imperial convoy to secure much-needed fuel, relying on their wits and their cantankerous droid Chopper to succeed.

1045.abstract: A force-sensitive orphan named Ezra Bridger has his life turned upside down when he encounters a small band of rebels fighting the Empire on his homeworld of Lothal.

1046.abstract: To create a diversion for a rebel operation, Mandalorian warrior and artist Sabine Wren uses her skills to tag an Imperial TIE fighter with the symbol of the growing rebellion.

1047.abstract: The Ghost crew needs a distraction, and Mandalorian artist Sabine Wren provides it by leaving her colorful, explosive mark on an Imperial TIE fighter.

1048.abstract: While her friends carry out a mission, Sabine Wren uses her artistic talents to sabotage and redecorate an Imperial TIE fighter, leaving a symbol of defiance for all to see.

1049.abstract: Aboard the Ghost, Captain Hera Syndulla reflects on the reasons she fights and the hope that fuels her commitment to the rebellion against the Galactic Empire.

1050.abstract: While on a supply run in a Lothal marketplace, the Lasat warrior Garazeb 'Zeb' Orrelios gets into a brawl with a squad of stormtroopers, creating a chaotic diversion for his crew.

1051.abstract: A simple supply run turns into a brawl when the Ghost crew's muscle, Zeb Orrelios, takes on a squad of stormtroopers in a crowded Lothal market.

1052.abstract: When stormtroopers hassle citizens in a Lothal market, the mighty Lasat Zeb Orrelios steps in to teach the Imperial bullies a lesson.

1053.abstract: The Lasat rebel Zeb Orrelios finds himself in a tangle with Imperial stormtroopers during what was supposed to be a quiet trip to a Lothal market.

1054.abstract: The Ghost crew's newest member, Ezra Bridger, defends his secret hideout in an abandoned communications tower from an inquisitive Imperial TIE fighter pilot.

1055.abstract: Ezra Bridger, the newest member of the Ghost crew, shows off his secret tower hideout, only to have it discovered and attacked by an Imperial TIE fighter pilot.

1056.abstract: On the streets of Lothal, a young thief named Ezra Bridger has a fateful encounter with Kanan Jarrus, a Jedi in hiding and the leader of a small rebel cell.

1057.abstract: Street-smart orphan Ezra Bridger is drawn into a small band of rebels fighting the Empire, discovering his own connection to the Force while helping rescue Wookiees from the spice mines of Kessel.

1058.abstract: The story of how a lonely, Force-sensitive orphan named Ezra Bridger met the rebellious crew of the Ghost and joined their fight for freedom on the planet Lothal.

1059.abstract: The adventure begins as young Ezra Bridger of Lothal is swept up into the Ghost crew's mission to free Wookiee slaves from the clutches of the Galactic Empire on Kessel.

1060.abstract: A young thief named Ezra discovers the Force and a new family when he joins Kanan Jarrus and the crew of the Ghost in their fight against the Empire on Lothal.

1061.abstract: Young Ezra Bridger joins a team of rebels on a dangerous mission to the planet Kessel to free a group of captured Wookiees from an Imperial labor camp.

1062.abstract: Kanan, Hera, and the rest of the Ghost crew plan and execute a daring heist to steal valuable supplies from the Galactic Empire on Lothal.

1063.abstract: Ezra Bridger adjusts to his new life as a member of the Ghost crew, learning from Kanan Jarrus and finding his place among the small band of rebels.

1064.abstract: On Lothal, the Jedi Kanan Jarrus tests the street-smart orphan Ezra Bridger to gauge his connection to the Force.

1065.abstract: After being captured by Imperial forces, Ezra Bridger uses his wits and burgeoning Force abilities to escape custody.

1066.abstract: The crew of the Ghost travels to the spice mines of Kessel to liberate a group of enslaved Wookiees from the Galactic Empire.

1067.abstract: The Ghost crew intercepts a shipment of illegal weapons on Garel, only to discover the cargo is actually the droids R2-D2 and C-3PO on a secret mission for Senator Bail Organa.

1068.abstract: Kanan Jarrus, a Jedi in hiding, must balance his duty to the burgeoning rebellion with his responsibility to train a new Force-sensitive apprentice.

1069.abstract: On a mission to disrupt an Imperial weapons shipment, the Ghost crew inadvertently gets entangled with the droids R2-D2 and C-3PO, leading them to an encounter with Senator Bail Organa.

1070.abstract: After a supply run goes awry, Ezra and Zeb must learn to work together when they steal an Imperial TIE fighter and cause chaos across Lothal.

1071.abstract: Ezra and Zeb's bickering leads them to joyride in a stolen TIE fighter, forcing them to cooperate to evade Imperial pursuit.

1072.abstract: The Ghost crew participates in a dangerous ring race to win vital supplies for their rebellion.

1073.abstract: Following a rumor of a captured Jedi Master, the Ghost crew infiltrates an old Separatist prison known as the Spire, only to walk into a trap laid by the Grand Inquisitor.

1074.abstract: The crew of the Ghost undertakes various missions against the Galactic Empire, from participating in dangerous races to evading Imperial agents.

1075.abstract: Lured by a false transmission, Kanan and Ezra attempt to rescue a Jedi Master from an Imperial prison, leading to a direct confrontation with the Grand Inquisitor.

1076.abstract: During a mission to acquire supplies, Kanan Jarrus attempts to teach his impatient Padawan, Ezra Bridger, a crucial lesson about the Force and patience.

1077.abstract: Zare Leonis, a cadet at the Imperial Academy for Lothal, navigates the treacherous environment of the Empire from within, secretly searching for his missing sister while aiding a rebel spy in his ranks.

1078.abstract: Ezra Bridger infiltrates the Imperial Academy on Lothal to steal a decoder, befriending fellow cadets Zare Leonis and Jai Kell to help them escape the Empire's grasp.

1079.abstract: The Ghost crew investigates reports of a Jedi on Garel, only to discover a con artist using the Jedi's reputation for personal gain.

1080.abstract: ISB Agent Kallus relentlessly hunts the Lasat rebel Garazeb Orrelios through the wilds of Lothal, seeking to finally capture his elusive prey.

1081.abstract: Rebels Ezra Bridger and Kanan Jarrus engage Imperial forces across the galaxy in a series of daring strikes.

1082.abstract: While on a supply run, Hera and Sabine become stranded at a remote, abandoned Republic base on an asteroid, where they must survive against both the elements and terrifying native creatures.

1083.abstract: Ace pilot Hera Syndulla takes the Phantom on a solo flight to outmaneuver Imperial patrols and deliver critical intelligence for the rebellion.

1084.abstract: On Garel, Hera Syndulla and Sabine Wren work together to secure a vital power generator for the fleet, proving their resourcefulness against Imperial interference.

1085.abstract: The astromech droid Chopper evades capture while navigating treacherous environments to complete his mission.

1086.abstract: Members of the Ghost crew undertake reconnaissance missions on Lothal and other worlds, gathering intelligence and liberating citizens from Imperial control.

1087.abstract: The Ghost crew disrupts the Empire's annual propaganda parade on Lothal, an event that forces Ezra to confront his past and the fate of his parents.

1088.abstract: While evading Imperial forces after disrupting the Empire Day parade, Ezra Bridger taps into a darker side of the Force to protect his friends from the Grand Inquisitor.

1089.abstract: On the anniversary of the Empire's founding, Ezra Bridger and the Ghost crew execute a daring plan to sabotage the Imperial parade on Lothal.

1090.abstract: Kanan and Ezra are pursued by the Grand Inquisitor to an abandoned asteroid base, where Ezra taps into the dark side of the Force to save his master.

1091.abstract: At Fort Anaxes, Kanan and Ezra face off against the Grand Inquisitor, forcing Ezra to unleash a powerful, uncontrolled Force ability to survive.

1092.abstract: The Ghost crew returns to the spice mines of Kessel to liberate another group of Wookiee prisoners from Imperial slavers.

1093.abstract: Ezra and Zeb's rivalry comes to a head as they compete against each other during a mission to secure a valuable prize for the rebellion.

1094.abstract: While on a mission with the Ghost crew, Kanan Jarrus is forced to confront his past as the Jedi Padawan Caleb Dume during the final days of the Clone Wars.

1095.abstract: Kanan Jarrus recounts the harrowing events of Order 66 on Mygeeto and his subsequent escape, revealing the moment Caleb Dume ceased to be a Jedi.

1096.abstract: Aboard the Ghost, Kanan Jarrus concludes the story of his past, reflecting on his journey from a fugitive Padawan to a Knight of the growing rebellion.

1097.abstract: Kanan takes Ezra to a hidden Jedi Temple on Lothal, where the young Padawan must face his greatest fears in a trial to determine his path as a Jedi.

1098.abstract: To advance his training, Ezra Bridger enters a Jedi Temple on Lothal, confronting visions of the past and future to find his inner strength.

1099.abstract: The Spectres continue their fight against the Empire, undertaking missions that test their skills, resolve, and trust in one another.

1100.abstract: Inside an ancient Jedi Temple, Kanan Jarrus guides his apprentice Ezra Bridger through a series of trials designed to test his connection to the Force.

1101.abstract: Sabine and Zeb must uncover a saboteur after a critical shipment of supplies for the rebellion is mysteriously contaminated.

1102.abstract: The Ghost crew crosses paths with the charming smuggler Lando Calrissian, who wins Chopper in a game of sabacc and embroils the rebels in a dangerous smuggling scheme.

1103.abstract: After Zeb loses Chopper to the smooth-talking Lando Calrissian in a game of sabacc, the crew must help the smuggler to get their droid back.

1104.abstract: Cadet Zare Leonis continues his undercover mission at the Imperial Academy on Lothal, seeking the truth about his missing sister while navigating the Empire's harsh justice.

1105.abstract: The Spectres arrange a meeting with a supposed rebel sympathizer, Senator-in-exile Gall Trayvis, only to discover he is an Imperial agent setting a trap for dissidents.

1106.abstract: A retelling of the Spectres' encounter with the treacherous Senator-in-exile Gall Trayvis, who attempts to lure them into an Imperial trap on Lothal.

1107.abstract: While meditating, Ezra Bridger has a Force vision of a dangerous Imperial trap, which helps the Spectres avoid disaster during a mission.

1108.abstract: Agent Kallus reflects on his pursuit of the Spectres, detailing his strategies and frustrations in trying to capture the elusive rebel cell on Lothal.

1109.abstract: The Grand Inquisitor evaluates Agent Kallus's performance and tactics in his ongoing hunt for the Jedi Kanan Jarrus and his apprentice.

1110.abstract: Zare Leonis enrolls in the Imperial Academy for Young Imperials on Lothal, secretly searching for clues about the disappearance of his Force-sensitive sister, Dhara.

1111.abstract: In a bold move, the Spectres hijack Lothal's main Imperial communication tower to broadcast a message of rebellion, but the mission ends with Kanan Jarrus being captured by the Grand Inquisitor.

1112.abstract: A retelling of the Spectres' daring mission to hijack an Imperial comm tower on Lothal, which results in the capture of Kanan Jarrus.

1113.abstract: Zare Leonis and Mereen Spanjaf risk everything to help the Spectres and uncover the Empire's darkest secrets on Lothal, culminating in a desperate escape.

1114.abstract: With Kanan Jarrus captured by the Empire, the remaining Spectres launch a desperate search to find his location, clashing with Imperial forces and seeking help from unconventional sources.

1115.abstract: The Spectres stage a daring rescue of Kanan Jarrus from Grand Moff Tarkin's Star Destroyer over Mustafar, leading to a final confrontation with the Grand Inquisitor and the revelation of a larger rebel network.

1116.abstract: Senator Bail Organa subtly navigates the treacherous politics of the Imperial Senate, working behind the scenes to support the growing rebellion against the Empire.

1117.abstract: The Ghost crew undertakes a mission to rescue stranded refugees from an oceanic platform on Lothal while evading Imperial patrols.

1118.abstract: Lando Calrissian finds himself caught between the Spectres and the Empire on Lothal, using his wits and charm to play both sides for his own profit.

1119.abstract: Zeb and Ezra's attempt to acquire supplies goes awry when they encounter a cargo of puffer pigs, leading to chaotic and explosive results.

1123.abstract: After joining the larger Rebel fleet, the Spectres return to Lothal to extract an Imperial defector, only to face the full might of the Empire and the terrifying arrival of Darth Vader.

1124.abstract: A retelling of the Spectres' return to Lothal, where their mission to aid a defector becomes a desperate fight for survival against the newly arrived Darth Vader.

1125.abstract: The Spectres carry out various missions against Imperial forces on Lothal, utilizing each member's unique skills to sabotage the Empire and aid the fledgling rebellion.

1126.abstract: An animated retelling of Darth Vader's devastating single-handed assault on the Phoenix Squadron fleet, showcasing his formidable piloting skills and connection to the Force.

1127.abstract: On a mission from Ahsoka Tano, the Spectres travel to the remote world of Seelos to find a legendary military strategist, only to discover a trio of aging clone troopers led by Captain Rex.

1128.abstract: A retelling of the Spectres' search for a hidden rebel base location, which leads them to the planet Seelos and an unexpected encounter with the clone veterans Captain Rex, Wolffe, and Gregor.

1129.abstract: After the Spectres depart, the Empire tracks them to Seelos, forcing the clone veterans and the rebels to join forces to fight off an Imperial assault led by Agent Kallus.

1130.abstract: Sabine Wren and Ezra Bridger infiltrate a Sienar Fleet Systems facility on Lothal to steal vital intelligence on the new TIE Advanced v1 prototype.

1131.abstract: While searching for supplies on an abandoned medical station, Ezra, Sabine, and Zeb are ambushed by two new Inquisitors, the Fifth Brother and the Seventh Sister, barely escaping with their lives.

1132.abstract: A retelling of a supply run to a derelict medical station where Ezra, Sabine, and Zeb face a terrifying new threat in the form of two deadly Imperial Inquisitors.

1133.abstract: Responding to a distress call, Ezra Bridger encounters the infamous pirate Hondo Ohnaka and gets drawn into a scheme involving a stolen Imperial transport and a disgruntled Cikatro Vizago.

1134.abstract: Players take on the role of Ezra Bridger, infiltrating Imperial facilities on Lothal to steal supplies and disrupt the Empire's operations.

1135.abstract: To break an Imperial blockade and deliver supplies, Hera Syndulla seeks out a reclusive Mon Calamari engineer to acquire a powerful new prototype starfighter: the B-wing.

1136.abstract: A retelling of Hera Syndulla's quest to obtain the B-wing prototype from its creator, the Mon Calamari engineer Quarrie, to aid a blockaded planet.

1137.abstract: The Seventh Sister and Fifth Brother hunt for the Spectres on Lothal, demonstrating their ruthless methods and rivalry in their pursuit of the Jedi.

1138.abstract: While on a mission to retrieve a courier for the rebellion, Sabine Wren is forced to confront her past when she runs into her former partner and bounty hunter, Ketsu Onyo.

1139.abstract: Agent Kallus sets a trap for the Spectres on Lothal, but his plan is complicated by the interference of the ambitious Inquisitors.

1140.abstract: Chopper engages in a high-stakes game of sabacc against Zeb, using his usual cunning and trickery to attempt to win the pot.

1141.abstract: When Ezra and Commander Sato are captured aboard a new Imperial Interdictor cruiser, Kanan and Rex must infiltrate the vessel to rescue them before it's too late.

1142.abstract: While on a personal errand, Jyn Erso notices stormtroopers confiscating a young girl's pet Tooka-cat and decides to intervene, creating a diversion to get it back.

1143.abstract: A pair of stormtroopers on Lothal have a particularly difficult day dealing with minor rebel disruptions that hint at the Spectres' larger activities.

1144.abstract: Ahsoka Tano joins Kanan Jarrus and Ezra Bridger on a mission to rescue two Force-sensitive children from the clutches of the Imperial Inquisitors, the Fifth Brother and the Seventh Sister.

1145.abstract: A retelling of the mission where Jedi Knight Kanan Jarrus and his allies race against Imperial Inquisitors to find and protect Force-sensitive infants.

1149.abstract: To prove herself worthy of the throne, sixteen-year-old Princess Leia Organa undertakes demanding challenges of body, heart, and mind, while secretly discovering her parents' involvement in a rebellion against the Galactic Empire.

1150.abstract: A young Princess Leia Organa navigates the dangerous world of Imperial politics and her own royal trials, all while being drawn into the secret formation of the Rebel Alliance.

1151.abstract: Princess Leia Organa and Luke Skywalker undertake a diplomatic mission on the frozen world of Hoth, facing both environmental dangers and Imperial scrutiny.

1152.abstract: Kanan Jarrus and Hera Syndulla infiltrate a remote Imperial refueling station, using their unique skills and bond to sabotage a critical enemy asset.

1153.abstract: A brave Ewok warrior rallies his tribe to defend their forest home from encroaching Imperial forces, proving that courage is not measured by size.

1154.abstract: Troubling visions lead Ezra Bridger back to his homeworld of Lothal, where he uncovers the tragic truth about his parents' fate at the hands of the Galactic Empire.

1155.abstract: A young rebel, Ezra Bridger, follows visions of his long-lost parents, returning to his home planet to confront the Empire and discover his family's legacy.

1156.abstract: A young Princess Leia Organa arrives on Lothal with vital ships for the rebellion, requiring Ezra Bridger and the Ghost crew to help her outsmart the Empire to secure them.

1157.abstract: In need of a safe passage through Mandalorian space, Kanan and Sabine confront the Protectors of Concord Dawn, forcing Sabine to deal with her people's complicated past.

1158.abstract: Mandalorian warrior Sabine Wren is forced to confront her past when the rebellion seeks passage through the territory of the formidable Protectors of Concord Dawn.

1159.abstract: The Spectres undertake a series of daring missions against the Galactic Empire, striking from the shadows to liberate worlds and inspire hope.

1160.abstract: Garazeb Orrelios must put his faith in an ancient Lasat prophecy to guide his people through a dangerous stellar phenomenon to their long-lost homeworld of Lira San.

1161.abstract: Imperial cadets Zare Leonis and Beck Ollet navigate the strict regime of the Academy for Young Imperials on Lothal, balancing their duties with their own hidden agendas.

1162.abstract: While on a desperate search for fuel, the Ghost crew encounters a herd of massive, space-faring purrgil, forcing Ezra to form a unique connection to save his friends.

1163.abstract: While on a secret mission, Princess Leia Organa and Sabine Wren must combine their skills to escape the relentless pursuit of the assassin droid IG-88.

1164.abstract: Princess Leia Organa demonstrates her courage and leadership in a series of adventures, from daring missions on Hoth to outsmarting bounty hunters in the Outer Rim.

1165.abstract: Stranded in a massive scrapyard, the Ghost crew must use their wits and resourcefulness to repair their ship and escape Imperial patrols.

1166.abstract: An unfortunate Imperial stormtrooper recounts his repeated and frustrating encounters with the elusive Spectres, the rebel cell causing chaos for the Empire.

1167.abstract: Jedi Knight Kanan Jarrus and his Padawan Ezra Bridger execute a daring plan to hijack an Imperial cargo train, disrupting the Empire's supply lines.

1168.abstract: Hera Syndulla returns to her homeworld of Ryloth on a dangerous mission, forcing a reunion with her estranged father, the famed Twi'lek freedom fighter Cham Syndulla.

1169.abstract: Kanan Jarrus recounts his harrowing escape from Order 66 as a young Padawan, reflecting on the lessons taught by his master, Depa Billaba, and the day the Jedi fell.

1170.abstract: Before joining the rebellion, a young Ezra Bridger uses his street smarts to navigate the criminal underworld of Lothal, learning a valuable lesson about choosing his allies.

1171.abstract: After a skirmish, Lasat rebel Garazeb Orrelios and Imperial Agent Kallus are stranded together on an icy moon, forcing the bitter enemies to rely on each other for survival.

1172.abstract: Seeking knowledge about the Sith, Kanan, Ezra, and Ahsoka enter the Jedi Temple on Lothal, where they are confronted by powerful visions of the past, present, and future.

1173.abstract: On a supply run, Zeb Orrelios and Ezra Bridger run afoul of a local crime syndicate, forcing them to fight their way out of a tight spot.

1174.abstract: A disillusioned Imperial pilot, seeking to defect, must prove his loyalty to the Rebel Alliance by undertaking a dangerous test mission.

1175.abstract: After being left behind on a mission, Chopper befriends a pragmatic Imperial inventory droid and convinces him to join the rebellion, securing a valuable asset for the fleet.

1176.abstract: As the rebels establish a new base on the remote world of Atollon, they discover the planet is inhabited by dangerous creatures that threaten their new home.

1177.abstract: During a training exercise, Ahsoka Tano teaches Ezra Bridger a valuable lesson in combat by disarming him, forcing him to rely on the Force and his wits.

1178.abstract: Sabine Wren tries to convince her old bounty hunting partner, Ketsu Onyo, to join the Rebel Alliance, testing their renewed friendship and Ketsu's loyalties.

1179.abstract: Sabine Wren gives a reluctant and blind Kanan Jarrus a flying lesson in a captured TIE fighter, which proves unexpectedly useful when Imperials attack.

1180.abstract: The Spectres plan a heist to intercept a valuable Imperial cargo shipment on the planet Thune, hoping to secure much-needed supplies for the rebellion.

1181.abstract: ISB Agent Kallus relentlessly pursues the Ghost crew, determined to capture the rebel cell and prove his unwavering loyalty to the Galactic Empire.

1182.abstract: Drawn by the Force to the forbidden Sith world of Malachor, Ahsoka Tano, Kanan Jarrus, and Ezra Bridger enter an ancient temple where they confront Maul and a devastating battle with Darth Vader.

1183.abstract: A Jedi Knight, his Padawan, and a former Jedi journey to the ancient world of Malachor, where a confrontation within a Sith temple against Inquisitors, Maul, and Darth Vader will change them forever.

1184.abstract: On Garel, Hera Syndulla and Sabine Wren must create a diversion to help a fellow rebel pilot escape an Imperial blockade.

1185.abstract: A chance encounter on Garel forces Sabine Wren and Jyn Erso to cooperate to retrieve a valuable data tape from Imperial stormtroopers.

1186.abstract: Rebel spy Cassian Andor infiltrates an Imperial security outpost on Wecacoe, where he encounters and forcibly reprograms the security droid K-2SO, gaining an unlikely and begrudging ally.

1187.abstract: Darth Vader relentlessly pursues a mysterious assassin across the galaxy, only to discover the hunter is a disillusioned Imperial loyalist who believes Vader has betrayed the Empire's true purpose.

1189.abstract: Spectres Ezra Bridger and Sabine Wren undertake a risky mission on Lothal to acquire fuel for the rebellion, facing off against Imperial forces in a test of their skills and teamwork.

1190.abstract: The Spectres crash the Empire's "Grand Imperial Jubilee" on Lothal, turning a propaganda event into an opportunity to strike a blow for the rebellion.

1191.abstract: The crew of the Ghost travels to Garel to protect a species of endangered creatures from a ruthless Imperial officer seeking to exploit them.

1192.abstract: The Spectres' rescue mission on Garel escalates as they directly confront the Imperial officer and his forces to ensure the survival of the planet's rare wildlife.

1193.abstract: A more powerful Ezra Bridger leads a reckless mission that attracts the attention of the brilliant Grand Admiral Thrawn, forcing Kanan Jarrus to seek guidance from a mysterious and powerful Force-being named Bendu.

1194.abstract: Maul returns and takes the Ghost crew hostage, forcing Ezra and Kanan to retrieve a Sith holocron. The subsequent merging of Jedi and Sith holocrons grants both Ezra and Maul a dangerous, fragmented vision of their destinies.

1195.abstract: In a desperate bid to save his friends, Ezra Bridger must unite a Jedi and Sith holocron with the former Sith Lord Maul, unleashing a powerful and dangerous vision of the future.

1196.abstract: Haunted by visions of Maul, Ezra is lured to Dathomir to partake in a dark side ritual to decipher their shared vision, leading to a confrontation with the spirits of the Nightsisters.

1197.abstract: Drawn by a shared vision, Maul travels to the desert world of Tatooine to find his old nemesis, leading to a final, fateful confrontation with Obi-Wan Kenobi.

1198.abstract: Sabine Wren infiltrates the Empire's elite Skystrike Academy to persuade several promising young pilots, including Wedge Antilles, to defect and join the growing Rebel Alliance.

1199.abstract: On a mission to her homeworld of Ryloth, Hera Syndulla must outwit the calculating Grand Admiral Thrawn to reclaim a priceless family heirloom and inspire her people.

1200.abstract: At Skystrike Academy, Imperial cadets Wedge Antilles and Rake Gahree engage in a friendly but intense rivalry during a training exercise, testing the limits of their piloting skills.

1201.abstract: Investigating a derelict battlefield, Captain Rex, Kanan, and Ezra are captured by a unit of battle droids still fighting the Clone Wars and are forced to participate in one final battle to settle the old conflict.

1202.abstract: After losing contact with the Protectors of Concord Dawn, Sabine Wren and Ezra Bridger discover that Imperial-allied Mandalorians, led by the ruthless Gar Saxon, have taken over the system.

1203.abstract: Members of the Spectres undertake a series of covert missions against Imperial forces, sabotaging facilities and rescuing prisoners to aid the growing rebellion.

1204.abstract: An Imperial stormtrooper stationed on Lothal begins to question his allegiance to the Empire after witnessing its cruelty firsthand.

1205.abstract: Hera Syndulla and Kanan Jarrus undertake a vital supply run for the rebellion, facing Imperial patrols and unforeseen obstacles that test their partnership.

1206.abstract: The Spectres attempt to evacuate a small, reckless rebel cell from the Mykapo system before the arrival of Grand Admiral Thrawn and the full might of the Imperial fleet.

1207.abstract: In need of weapons, the Spectres form an uneasy alliance with pirates Hondo Ohnaka and Azmorigan to salvage valuable cargo from a disabled Imperial freighter trapped in the turbulent atmosphere of Wynkahthu.

1208.abstract: Kanan and Ezra go undercover inside a Lothal arms factory to sabotage the Imperial war machine, only to discover a high-ranking Imperial officer is secretly the new rebel informant, Fulcrum.

1209.abstract: On a seemingly simple mission, C-3PO and R2-D2 get separated and find themselves entangled with a group of droids planning a small-scale rebellion of their own.

1210.abstract: As a young Padawan, Caleb Dume accompanies his master Depa Billaba on a mission, where his impulsive nature is put to the test against a surprising threat.

1211.abstract: Plagued by visions, Ezra Bridger is drawn into an alliance with Maul on the haunted world of Dathomir to complete a dark ritual and understand their shared vision, awakening vengeful Nightsister spirits in the process.

1212.abstract: To acquire information for the rebellion, Zeb Orrelios and Ezra Bridger go undercover in a high-stakes fighting tournament on Garel, testing their combat skills and their ability to work together.

1213.abstract: The Imperial Inquisitors known as the Fifth Brother and Seventh Sister relentlessly hunt their Jedi prey on the planet Ovanis, showcasing their deadly rivalry and devotion to the dark side.

1214.abstract: The Spectres are dispatched to Geonosis to locate the extremist rebel Saw Gerrera, uncovering evidence of an Imperial genocide and a terrifying superweapon project.

1215.abstract: The discovery of a new, highly intelligent Imperial probe droid on Atollon forces the Spectres into a race against time to neutralize the threat before it can transmit the location of their hidden base.

1216.abstract: To rally the clans of Mandalore, Kanan Jarrus trains Sabine Wren to wield the legendary Darksaber, a process that forces her to confront the painful history of her family and her Imperial past.

1217.abstract: Wielding the Darksaber, Sabine Wren returns to her estranged family on Krownest to seek their aid for the rebellion, but must first confront her past and challenge the Imperial Viceroy Gar Saxon for leadership.

1218.abstract: While seeking artistic inspiration at a market on Garel, Sabine Wren uses her creative talents and combat skills to protect a local artisan from Imperial harassment.

1221.abstract: With Grand Admiral Thrawn closing in on the identity of the rebel spy Fulcrum, Agent Kallus must risk everything to transmit vital intelligence from Lothal, leading to a tense game of cat and mouse.

1223.abstract: The Spectres undertake a perilous mission to transport Senator Mon Mothma, now a fugitive of the Empire, to a secret rendezvous where she will formally unite the disparate rebel cells into the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

1224.abstract: Garazeb Orrelios recounts a tale from his days in the Lasan Honor Guard, facing a fearsome native beast in a trial that tested his strength and courage.

1225.abstract: Imperial analyst droid AP-5 and astromech C1-10P "Chopper" infiltrate an Imperial command ship to steal clearance codes, but Chopper is compromised, forcing AP-5 to outwit both the Empire and his friend to save the rebellion.

1226.abstract: Guided by a holocron, Ezra Bridger travels to the desolate world of Tatooine to warn an old Jedi Master of a looming threat, only to find himself a pawn in a final, fateful confrontation between two legendary rivals.

1227.abstract: Grand Admiral Thrawn executes his long-awaited attack on the rebel base on Atollon, trapping Phoenix Squadron and forcing them into a desperate battle for survival that requires an unexpected sacrifice.

1228.abstract: Grand Admiral Thrawn and Darth Vader are dispatched to investigate a disturbance on the planet Batuu, forcing the two to confront a threat from Thrawn's past and testing their strained alliance.

1229.abstract: In an adaptation of the novel, Grand Admiral Thrawn and Darth Vader investigate a threat on Batuu, forcing them to recall a past mission together during the Clone Wars.

1234.abstract: An Imperial nurse develops a dangerous obsession with Darth Vader after treating his injuries, believing she sees a noble man trapped within the armor and going to extreme lengths to get close to him.

1235.abstract: A Wookiee warrior on Kashyyyk encounters a mysterious witch who helps protect his village from Imperial slavers, teaching him about the balance of the forest.

1236.abstract: A collection of intercepted communications and internal memos from across the galaxy reveals snippets of Imperial military operations, Rebel intelligence, and civilian life under the Empire's rule.

1237.abstract: A former Jedi Padawan, living in hiding as a simple woodcutter, is forced to confront his past when Imperial forces arrive in his village, threatening the peace he has struggled to maintain.

1238.abstract: Chewbacca and a young cargo-scanner named Mayvleen get stranded on a spooky forest world, where they must overcome their fears and outwit a creepy droid collector to escape.

1239.abstract: Alton Kastle, the voice of the HoloNet News on Lothal, grapples with his role as an Imperial propagandist as he witnesses the growing rebellion and the harsh realities of the Empire's control.

1240.abstract: A team of the galaxy's deadliest bounty hunters, led by the cyborg Beilert Valance, is hired by a hidden crime syndicate to do the impossible: eliminate Darth Vader.

1247.abstract: A Force-sensitive smuggler is captured and taken to Darth Vader's fortress on Mustafar, where they uncover an ancient secret and are forced to confront the Dark Lord himself to determine the fate of the fiery world.

1250.abstract: Sabine Wren returns to her homeworld to rescue her father, but finds herself forced to confront the superweapon she created for the Empire and unite her people against Imperial rule.

1251.abstract: Dhara Leonis, a cadet at the Imperial Academy on Arkanis, navigates brutal training and political maneuvering, all while secretly searching for a way to escape the Empire's grasp.

1252.abstract: The Ghost crew joins the larger Rebel Alliance at Yavin 4, but Ezra and Sabine grow frustrated with leadership's caution and undertake a rogue mission with Saw Gerrera to investigate a massive Imperial secret weapon.

1253.abstract: On the jungle world of Teth, bounty hunter Aurra Sing finds herself in a deadly competition with her rival Cad Bane to capture a valuable target, testing their skills and their fragile alliance.

1254.abstract: The Ghost crew returns to Lothal to find it under a brutal Imperial occupation, forcing them to go underground and seek help from old friends to begin liberating Ezra's homeworld.

1255.abstract: Ezra and Sabine infiltrate an Imperial airfield on Lothal to steal the prototype for the advanced TIE Defender, attracting the personal attention of Grand Admiral Thrawn.

1256.abstract: Pursued by Thrawn's forces, the rebels are guided to safety by mysterious Loth-wolves, revealing a deep, mystical connection between the Force, Ezra, and his homeworld.

1257.abstract: In need of a long-range transmitter to contact Rebel command, the Ghost crew hijacks a massive Imperial ore crawler, but must contend with its eccentric and stubborn Trandoshan captain.

1258.abstract: Rebel pilot John D. Branon, known as Red Four, recounts his harrowing experiences during the Battle of Scarif and the events leading up to the attack on the first Death Star.

1259.abstract: Rebel pilots Thane Kyrell and Kendy Idele undertake a risky training exercise near Yavin 4, reflecting on their pasts and the choices that led them to join the Alliance.

1260.abstract: Hera Syndulla leads a daring X-wing assault on the Imperial command center on Lothal, but the attack goes disastrously wrong, leading to her capture by Grand Admiral Thrawn.

1261.abstract: The Ghost crew launches a desperate mission to rescue Hera from Imperial custody on Lothal, requiring the ultimate sacrifice from Kanan Jarrus, who embraces his destiny as a Jedi Knight to save those he loves.

1262.abstract: Grand Admiral Thrawn's TIE Defender project is threatened by Director Krennic's rival Stardust initiative, forcing him to navigate treacherous Imperial politics while confronting a new threat from the Unknown Regions.

1263.abstract: Reeling from the loss of Kanan, the surviving members of the Ghost crew struggle with their grief while Ezra seeks guidance from the Loth-wolves, who reveal a new mission connected to the Jedi Temple.

1264.abstract: In the Imperial-occupied Holy City on Jedha, former Guardians of the Whills Baze Malbus and Chirrut Îmwe resist the Empire in their own ways, until the arrival of extremist Saw Gerrera forces them to choose a side.

1265.abstract: On the occupied holy moon of Jedha, two former Guardians of the Whills, Chirrut Îmwe and Baze Malbus, resist the Galactic Empire's oppressive rule and protect the downtrodden.

1266.abstract: A team of smugglers undertakes a secret mission on the Imperial-occupied moon of Jedha, navigating dangers to secure a valuable prize.

1267.abstract: Guided by the mysterious Loth-wolves and ancient paintings, Ezra Bridger and the Ghost crew seek a hidden entrance to the Lothal Jedi Temple to stop the Empire's plans.

1268.abstract: Inside the Lothal Jedi Temple, Ezra Bridger discovers a mystical realm outside of time and space, where he confronts Emperor Palpatine and makes a fateful choice that alters destiny.

1269.abstract: Ezra Bridger returns to his allies to rally a final, desperate assault against Grand Admiral Thrawn's forces to liberate his homeworld of Lothal.

1270.abstract: In a climactic final battle for Lothal, Ezra Bridger makes the ultimate sacrifice to defeat Grand Admiral Thrawn and ensure his homeworld's freedom from the Empire.

1271.abstract: A Mustafarian legend tells of a brave warrior who ventures into the lava flows to confront a slumbering beast, seeking to protect their village from its fiery wrath.

1272.abstract: Years after her fall from the Jedi Order, Barriss Offee finds a new purpose protecting a Force-sensitive child from the Empire, forcing her to confront her past and choose her future.

1273.abstract: On the planet Garel, a young Jyn Erso trades a datapad for a tooka doll, but her act of kindness towards a hungry creature leads to an unexpected reward.

1274.abstract: A tribe of Tusken Raiders on Tatooine encounters a landspeeder left behind by a mysterious old hermit, viewing it as a gift from the desert itself.

1275.abstract: An Alderaanian slicer hiding on Tatooine intercepts a transmission from Princess Leia Organa, renewing her hope in the fight against the Empire.

1276.abstract: An Acolyte of the Beyond, known as the Grave Digger, scours the lava fields of Mustafar for Sith artifacts, seeking to commune with the dark side.

1277.abstract: While Han Solo is away, Chewbacca attempts to enjoy a quiet day aboard the Millennium Falcon, but is constantly interrupted by droids needing repairs.

1278.abstract: On Ord Tesse, C-3PO and R2-D2 must outwit the bounty hunter IG-88 to protect vital Rebel intelligence.

1279.abstract: The mighty Wookiee Chewbacca proves his loyalty and skill as the Millennium Falcon's co-pilot, helping his friends escape the Death Star and battle TIE fighters.

1280.abstract: After crash-landing on Mustafar, a Rebel crew takes shelter in Darth Vader's fortress, where Vader's attendant Vaneé shares a terrifying tale of Jedi Knights on another world.

1281.abstract: Trapped within Vader's Castle, a captured Rebel officer is told a chilling story about Han Solo and Chewbacca's encounter with a swamp creature of legend.

1282.abstract: As Rebels try to escape Vader's fortress, Vaneé recounts a spooky tale of Ewoks facing a monstrous threat in the forests of Endor's moon.

1283.abstract: A Mustafarian local tells a tale of the terrifying fortress of Darth Vader, setting the stage for another horrifying adventure within its walls.

1284.abstract: Vaneé shares a story of betrayal and dark power involving the Nightsisters of Dathomir, all while the captive Rebels plot their escape from the castle.

1285.abstract: In the finale, the Rebels make their final bid for freedom as Vaneé tells a story of Darth Vader himself hunting a rogue Imperial officer.

1286.abstract: A new group of adventurers finds themselves at the mercy of Vaneé in Vader's Castle, who tells a frightening story of Grand Moff Tarkin's past.

1287.abstract: Vaneé continues his torment by recounting a tale of Asajj Ventress facing a deadly curse while hunting a bounty.

1288.abstract: The captives in Vader's Castle are told a story of Jabba the Hutt's encounter with a fearsome creature in his own palace.

1289.abstract: A chilling tale of Darth Maul's relentless pursuit of a target is shared by Vaneé to break the spirits of his prisoners.

1290.abstract: As the prisoners make a desperate escape attempt, Vaneé reveals a final, terrifying story about the master of the castle, Darth Vader, and his unyielding power.

1291.abstract: A low-level Imperial officer develops a dangerous obsession with Darth Vader after witnessing his overwhelming power firsthand during a planetary crisis.

1292.abstract: A cocky starship captain finds himself the target of Darth Vader's relentless pursuit after a chance encounter, leading to a desperate chase through the void.

1293.abstract: A common thief on Coruscant witnesses the awe-inspiring and terrifying presence of Darth Vader, which profoundly changes the course of his life.

1294.abstract: On a mission to the droid manufacturing planet of Mechis III, Luke Skywalker and Princess Leia must shut down a rogue Imperial factory producing deadly battle droids.

1295.abstract: Kylo Ren, leader of the Knights of Ren, hunts a fugitive through the galaxy, proving that no one can escape the reach of the First Order.

1296.abstract: During the Clone Wars, General Grievous leads a brutal assault on a Republic cruiser, demonstrating his prowess as a Jedi hunter and ruthless Separatist commander.

1297.abstract: Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and his Master Obi-Wan Kenobi go undercover to liberate slaves from the treacherous spice mines of Kessel.

1298.abstract: On Mustafar, Darth Vader confronts a group of cultists who worship his power, forcing him to assert his dominance and extinguish their misguided reverence.

1299.abstract: The notorious bounty hunter Boba Fett is hired to eliminate a rival, a mission that takes him on a deadly pursuit through the Outer Rim.

1300.abstract: During his exile on Dagobah, Jedi Master Yoda protects his new home from offworld poachers, using the planet's own mysterious nature as his ally.

1493.abstract: In the aftermath of the Battle of Yavin, a small team of Rebel heroes infiltrates Cymoon 1, a massive Imperial weapons factory, in a bold act of sabotage that brings them face-to-face with Darth Vader.

1494.abstract: The Rebel strike on the Imperial weapons factory on Cymoon 1 goes awry, forcing Luke Skywalker into a direct confrontation with the fearsome Darth Vader.

1495.abstract: With their sabotage mission on Cymoon 1 in jeopardy, Han Solo and Princess Leia commandeer an AT-AT walker in a desperate attempt to escape the wrath of Darth Vader and his Imperial forces.

1496.abstract: Demoted by the Emperor after the Death Star's destruction, Darth Vader travels to Tatooine to forcefully negotiate with Jabba the Hutt and begins his personal, clandestine hunt for the Force-strong pilot who defied him.

1497.abstract: In the nascent days of the Empire, Emperor Palpatine reinforces his dominion over his apprentice, Darth Vader, reminding him of the power of the dark side and the pain that fuels it.

1498.abstract: Seeking to understand his Jedi path, Luke Skywalker returns to Obi-Wan Kenobi's abandoned hut on Tatooine, only to be ambushed by the notorious bounty hunter Boba Fett.

1499.abstract: Rebel spy Eneb Ray undertakes a high-stakes mission on Coruscant to assassinate Emperor Palpatine, forcing him to question the morality of his methods and the cost of war.

1500.abstract: The rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Aphra is forcibly recruited by Darth Vader to aid in his secret schemes, leading them on a perilous journey to acquire a private droid army and uncover the secrets of the pilot who destroyed the Death Star.

1501.abstract: Darth Vader continues his secret operations, dispatching bounty hunters across the galaxy while he and Doctor Aphra travel to Geonosis to secure a hidden asset for the Sith Lord's private use.

1502.abstract: On Geonosis, Darth Vader and Doctor Aphra activate a dormant droid foundry, unleashing a legion of deadly battle droids to serve as the Dark Lord's personal army.

1503.abstract: Darth Vader and Doctor Aphra must contend with the last surviving Geonosian Queen to seize full control of the droid factories and build a secret army loyal only to Vader.

1504.abstract: In a desperate confrontation in Obi-Wan Kenobi's former dwelling, Luke Skywalker manages to escape the clutches of Boba Fett, but not before the bounty hunter learns his name.

1505.abstract: While investigating a potential rival to his position, Darth Vader is confronted by the cybernetically enhanced warriors of the scientist Cylo, forcing him to prove his superiority in the dark side.

1506.abstract: While Luke Skywalker discovers a hidden journal left by Obi-Wan Kenobi, the bounty hunter Boba Fett delivers a name to Darth Vader that will change the fate of the galaxy: Skywalker.

1507.abstract: Seeking the identity of the Rebel pilot who destroyed the Death Star, Darth Vader travels to Tatooine to employ bounty hunters from Jabba the Hutt. He learns the pilot's name is Skywalker, a revelation that sends shockwaves through the Dark Lord.

1508.abstract: After being captured by the Hutt collector Grakkus, Luke Skywalker is forced into gladiatorial combat on the Smuggler's Moon. Han Solo and Princess Leia Organa mount a desperate rescue mission into the heart of the criminal underworld.

1509.abstract: Luke Skywalker's fight for survival continues in Grakkus the Hutt's arena, while Han, Leia, and Chewbacca navigate the dangers of the Smuggler's Moon to save their friend. The rescue becomes more perilous as Imperial forces close in on their location.

1510.abstract: The attempt to rescue Luke Skywalker from Grakkus the Hutt erupts into a chaotic battle across the Smuggler's Moon. The Rebels must contend with both the Hutt's enforcers and opportunistic bounty hunters.

1511.abstract: The chaotic situation on Nar Shaddaa escalates when an elite Imperial stormtrooper unit, led by Sergeant Kreel, arrives to capture Luke Skywalker. The Rebels find themselves caught in a three-way conflict between the Hutt's forces and the Empire.

1512.abstract: In a final, desperate battle, Luke Skywalker confronts the lightsaber-wielding stormtrooper Sergeant Kreel. The Rebels fight their way through the crossfire to make a daring escape from the Smuggler's Moon.

1513.abstract: Darth Vader finds his authority challenged by the brilliant Imperial Inspector Thanoth while investigating a heist. Simultaneously, he tasks Doctor Aphra with continuing the secret hunt for information about the pilot named Skywalker.

1514.abstract: To uncover the origins of the pilot Skywalker, Doctor Aphra travels to Naboo to investigate the history of the late Padmé Amidala. Meanwhile, Darth Vader and Inspector Thanoth close in on the criminals who robbed the Empire.

1515.abstract: Darth Vader's investigation leads him to a confrontation with the Plasma Devils criminal syndicate. The Dark Lord makes a brutal example of the thieves, all under the watchful eye of the shrewd Inspector Thanoth.

1516.abstract: Darth Vader is ambushed by a group of cybernetically enhanced warriors, all potential replacements created by the scientist Cylo. Vader must prove his power is superior to their advanced technology to maintain his standing with the Emperor.

1517.abstract: While Vader deals with his new rivals, Doctor Aphra travels to the criminal haven of Son-tuul to recruit a team of bounty hunters. Her mission is to steal a vast fortune to fund Vader's secret operations.

1518.abstract: Doctor Aphra and her crew of bounty hunters execute a high-stakes heist on Son-tuul. The operation is complicated when Inspector Thanoth arrives, having deduced a part of Vader's clandestine activities.

1519.abstract: Darth Vader is dispatched to the mining world of Shu-Torun to brutally suppress a rebellion against its Imperial-allied queen. The Dark Lord navigates the planet's treacherous politics and underground warfare to restore the Emperor's order.

1521.abstract: While hunting for Luke Skywalker, Darth Vader's TIE Advanced is shot down over the planet Vrogas Vas. Though stranded and alone, he finds himself surrounded by the entire Rebel fleet's ground forces, a situation he finds most agreeable.

1522.abstract: A lone Darth Vader turns the tables on the Rebel army, systematically dismantling their forces on Vrogas Vas. Doctor Aphra arrives with her droids and the bounty hunter Black Krrsantan to provide unexpected, and deadly, reinforcements.

1523.abstract: Separated from his allies, Luke Skywalker is hunted by Doctor Aphra's sadistic assassin droids. Meanwhile, Han and Leia attempt to spring a trap on Darth Vader, hoping to end his terror once and for all.

1524.abstract: The hunt for Luke Skywalker is complicated when Commander Karbin, a Mon Calamari cyborg rival to Vader, arrives on Vrogas Vas. The two Imperial agents clash in a fierce duel, both determined to capture the boy for the Emperor.

1525.abstract: Han Solo and Princess Leia are captured by the formidable Wookiee bounty hunter Black Krrsantan. This forces Luke Skywalker into a direct, desperate confrontation with Darth Vader amidst the raging battle.

1526.abstract: The battle of Vrogas Vas concludes with Darth Vader eliminating his Imperial rival and escaping the planet. However, his clandestine associate, Doctor Aphra, is captured by the victorious but battered Rebel Alliance.

1527.abstract: Princess Leia and Sana Starros transport their high-value prisoner, Doctor Aphra, to Sunspot Prison, a secret Rebel detention facility. Upon arrival, they discover a mysterious enemy has already infiltrated the station.

1528.abstract: An unknown assailant seizes control of Sunspot Prison, turning its security systems against the Rebels. Leia, Sana, and their prisoner Doctor Aphra must form an uneasy alliance to survive the lockdown and fight back.

1529.abstract: The identity of the prison's attacker is revealed, exposing a personal vendetta against the Rebellion. Leia, Sana, and Aphra are forced into a desperate battle for survival as Luke and Han race to the station.

1530.abstract: The siege of Sunspot Prison reaches its climax as Princess Leia and her unlikely allies confront their foe. The incident forces Leia to make a difficult command decision about the nature of justice within the Rebel Alliance.

1531.abstract: Darth Vader returns to the mining world of Shu-Torun, this time to aid Queen Trios in crushing a new rebellion by the planet's ore-dukes. The Dark Lord's brutal tactics escalate the conflict into a full-scale war.

1532.abstract: Leading the Imperial assault, Darth Vader begins a systematic campaign to destroy the rebellious ore-dukes of Shu-Torun. He uses overwhelming force and strategic terror to break the planet's will to resist.

1533.abstract: The ore-dukes of Shu-Torun deploy their ultimate weapons: colossal drilling machines repurposed for war. Darth Vader is forced to confront these mechanical behemoths to continue his conquest of the planet.

1534.abstract: The war for Shu-Torun concludes as Darth Vader makes a final, devastating move against the ore-dukes, securing the planet for the Empire. However, the victory is tainted by a final act of betrayal from his supposed allies.

1535.abstract: With the war on Shu-Torun concluded, Darth Vader turns his full attention to eliminating his rival, the scientist Cylo. Aboard the Super Star Destroyer Executor, Vader begins his hunt for Cylo and his remaining cybernetic abominations.

1536.abstract: The assassin droids Triple-Zero and BT-1 embark on a brief but violent escapade, showcasing their sadistic personalities and love for chaos while their master is otherwise occupied.

1537.abstract: Aboard the Executor, Darth Vader's hunt for Cylo's creations leads to a deadly confrontation with the cybernetic twins, Morit and Aiolin. The duel pits Vader's mastery of the Force against their advanced combat technology.

1538.abstract: Darth Vader tracks his rival Cylo to a hidden research station on the planet Crul. There, he uncovers the full, twisted extent of the scientist's experiments and prepares for their final confrontation.

1539.abstract: Cylo unleashes his ultimate creation: a fleet of living ships controlled by the transplanted consciousness of giant space-whales. Darth Vader must battle both the scientist and his monstrous fleet in the void of space.

1540.abstract: Vader confronts Tulon Voidgazer, another of Cylo's enhanced warriors, who wields a mysterious and powerful energy against him. Meanwhile, Imperial forces locate Doctor Aphra, who has been in hiding since her escape from Rebel custody.

1541.abstract: In a final, decisive battle aboard the Executor, Darth Vader destroys Cylo, ending the threat to his position and solidifying his role as the Emperor's fist. He then confronts Doctor Aphra to tie up the last loose end from his secret operations.

1542.abstract: During a critical diplomatic conference on Coruscant, Senator Padmé Amidala and Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker must work together to uncover a dangerous conspiracy threatening the stability of the Republic.

1543.abstract: Aboard a Rebel cruiser, R2-D2 single-handedly thwarts a group of mischievous scavenger droids that have infiltrated the ship. The resourceful astromech proves that size is no measure of a hero.

1544.abstract: The Rebel Alliance sets its sights on an audacious new goal: capturing an Imperial Star Destroyer. As the elite SCAR Squadron is dispatched to secure the vessel, the Rebels prepare their own daring plan to hijack it.

1545.abstract: A small Rebel strike team successfully boards the Star Destroyer Harbinger, only to find it defended by the elite SCAR Squadron. Luke, Leia, and Han must fight their way through the deadly stormtroopers to seize control of the bridge.

1546.abstract: The battle for the Harbinger intensifies as the Rebels are pinned down by the superior tactics of SCAR Squadron. Luke Skywalker is forced into a tense duel with the lightsaber-wielding Sergeant Kreel.

1547.abstract: A Rebel Alliance strike team, led by Leia Organa, undertakes a daring mission to capture an Imperial Star Destroyer, the Harbinger, to bolster their fleet.

1548.abstract: The Rebels' desperate attempt to steal the Imperial Star Destroyer Harbinger reaches its explosive climax against the elite SCAR Squadron.

1568.abstract: Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa travel to the aquatic world of Tibrin on a diplomatic mission that quickly turns dangerous when Imperial forces intervene.

1570.abstract: Han Solo and Chewbacca take on a seemingly simple smuggling job on the planet Cyrkon, only to find themselves caught in a deadly trap.

1571.abstract: On the Smuggler's Moon, Sana Starros is forced to confront her past when a bounty hunter comes to collect on an old debt.

1572.abstract: When C-3PO is captured by Imperial forces, the resourceful astromech R2-D2 embarks on a solo mission to rescue his counterpart from an Imperial salvage station.

1573.abstract: The loyal astromech R2-D2 must outwit a band of pirates on the junk planet of Kalarba to save his friend C-3PO from being sold for scrap.

1574.abstract: C-3PO's strict adherence to protocol is put to the test during a diplomatic mission that goes awry, forcing R2-D2 to once again save the day.

1575.abstract: A Rebel slicer on Coruscant must use his wits to escape an Imperial manhunt after a mission to steal vital data goes wrong.

1576.abstract: Princess Leia Organa works with Queen Trios to help rebuild the war-torn planet of Shu-Torun, navigating the delicate politics of a world recently freed from Imperial influence.

1577.abstract: The elite Imperial SCAR Squadron, led by Sergeant Kreel, hunts down the remnants of a Rebel cell on the desolate salt flats of Crait.

1578.abstract: Doctor Aphra recounts the brutal history of the Wookiee gladiator Black Krrsantan, revealing the dark path that led him to become one of the galaxy's most feared bounty hunters.

1579.abstract: Doctor Aphra orchestrates a high-stakes auction for an ancient Jedi artifact, attracting the most dangerous bidders in the galaxy and the unwanted attention of Darth Vader.
