1701.abstract: In a serialized retelling of the war, the Rebel Alliance suffers a devastating blow as Imperial forces launch a full-scale assault on their hidden base on the ice planet Hoth.

1702.abstract: Fleeing the Empire's wrath, the crew of the Millennium Falcon navigates a treacherous asteroid field while being relentlessly pursued by Darth Vader's fleet.

1703.abstract: The heroes scatter as Luke Skywalker follows the guidance of Obi-Wan's spirit to the Dagobah system, while Han Solo seeks refuge with an old friend in Cloud City on Bespin.

1704.abstract: Upon crashing on the swamp world of Dagobah, Luke Skywalker has a fateful and bewildering encounter with a diminutive, eccentric green creature who holds the key to his destiny.

1705.abstract: The small creature reveals himself to be the legendary Jedi Master Yoda, who reluctantly agrees to train Luke Skywalker in the ways of the Force after being convinced by the spirit of Obi-Wan Kenobi.

1706.abstract: Luke Skywalker undergoes rigorous Jedi training with Master Yoda, facing physical and spiritual challenges, including a dark vision within a cave strong with the dark side of the Force.

1707.abstract: On the swamp world of Dagobah, Jedi Master Yoda guides Luke Skywalker to a dark side cave to confront his deepest fears and the shadow of Darth Vader.

1708.abstract: During his training, Luke Skywalker receives a powerful Force vision of his friends in peril, forcing him to choose between his training and their safety.

1709.abstract: Seeking refuge, the crew of the Millennium Falcon arrives at Cloud City on Bespin, only to be welcomed into an elaborate trap set by Darth Vader.

1710.abstract: Ignoring the warnings of his masters, Luke Skywalker arrives on Cloud City and confronts Darth Vader in a desperate attempt to save his friends.

1711.abstract: In the depths of Cloud City, the duel between Luke Skywalker and Darth Vader reaches its climax, culminating in a shocking revelation that shatters Luke's world.

1712.abstract: Maimed and defeated, Luke Skywalker makes a desperate choice to escape Darth Vader's grasp, plunging into the abyss of Cloud City.

1713.abstract: Hanging beneath Cloud City, a weakened Luke Skywalker reaches out with the Force and is rescued by his friends aboard the Millennium Falcon.

1714.abstract: The Galactic Empire's colossal AT-AT walkers launch a devastating ground assault on the Rebel Alliance's Echo Base, forcing a desperate defense.

1715.abstract: The Rebel Alliance engages invading Imperial forces on the ice plains of Hoth, utilizing snowspeeders against the colossal AT-AT walkers in a desperate battle for survival.

1716.abstract: An Imperial AT-AT commander experiences the Battle of Hoth from the cockpit of his walker, witnessing firsthand the might of the Empire and the surprising resilience of the Rebellion.

1717.abstract: A Rebel mechanic working on the Millennium Falcon in Echo Base observes the complicated relationship between Han Solo and Princess Leia just before the Imperial assault.

1718.abstract: While on patrol, Luke Skywalker is attacked by a wampa and taken to its lair, forcing Han Solo to brave the deadly Hoth night to rescue his friend.

1719.abstract: During the evacuation of Echo Base, Rebel officer Toryn Farr must perfectly time a shot from the planetary ion cannon to clear a path for the escaping GR-75 transports.

1720.abstract: Rogue Squadron pilot Zev Senesca braves the unforgiving blizzards of Hoth in his snowspeeder to locate the missing Commander Skywalker and Captain Solo.

1721.abstract: A tauntaun's life force provides the critical warmth needed to save a stranded Rebel hero from freezing to death in the harsh, unforgiving cold of Hoth.

1722.abstract: Captured by a ferocious wampa, Luke Skywalker uses his growing connection to the Force to retrieve his lightsaber and escape the ice creature's lair.

1723.abstract: On the swamp world of Dagobah, Jedi Master Yoda begins training Luke Skywalker, teaching him that the power of the Force is not constrained by physical size.

1724.abstract: During the chaotic evacuation of Hoth, a squad of Rebel troopers must hold a critical chokepoint against advancing snowtroopers to buy time for their comrades to escape.

1725.abstract: Darth Vader personally leads the Imperial ground assault on Echo Base, relentlessly cutting through Rebel defenses to crush the heart of the Alliance.

1726.abstract: A Rebel xenobiologist stationed on Hoth documents the planet's unique and often dangerous wildlife, finding a deeper appreciation for the ecosystem amidst the turmoil of war.

1727.abstract: The Rebel Alliance's snowspeeders courageously engage the Empire's massive AT-AT walkers in a desperate battle across the frozen plains of Hoth.

1728.abstract: The full might of the Imperial army is unleashed on Hoth as colossal AT-AT walkers spearhead the assault against the Rebel Alliance's hidden Echo Base.

1729.abstract: General Carlist Rieekan makes the difficult decision to evacuate Echo Base, overseeing the chaotic retreat while grappling with the heavy cost of command.

1730.abstract: Aboard the Super Star Destroyer Executor, Admiral Ozzel's tactical blunder of exiting hyperspace too close to Hoth earns him a fatal punishment from an unforgiving Darth Vader.

1731.abstract: As he leads the Imperial assault on Echo Base, General Veers reflects on his shared history with the defending Rebel commander, General Rieekan, before their final, fateful confrontation.

1732.abstract: Filled with youthful confidence, Rogue Squadron gunner Dak Ralter flies into the Battle of Hoth with Luke Skywalker, ready to take on the whole Empire himself.

1733.abstract: Leading Rogue Squadron, Commander Luke Skywalker executes a daring maneuver with his snowspeeder's tow cable to trip up and destroy a massive Imperial AT-AT walker.

1734.abstract: Medical droid 2-1B works tirelessly to treat the wounded during the frantic evacuation of Echo Base, contemplating its programming and the nature of hope amid destruction.

1735.abstract: An Imperial snowtrooper in Blizzard Force experiences the ground assault on Echo Base, pushing relentlessly forward under the command of Darth Vader to crush the Rebellion.

1736.abstract: With Echo Base collapsing around them, Han Solo, Princess Leia, and Chewbacca race to the Millennium Falcon and blast their way out of the Imperial blockade.

1737.abstract: A team of Rebel operatives trapped on Hoth must solve a series of complex challenges to escape Echo Base before they are captured by the invading Imperial army.

1738.abstract: To evade the pursuing Imperial fleet, the Millennium Falcon flies into a dense asteroid field and takes refuge in a cave that is actually the gullet of a giant space slug.

1739.abstract: Following the devastating loss at Hoth, Wedge Antilles leads the scattered remnants of Rogue Squadron through Imperial patrols to reach the Alliance's secret rendezvous point.

1740.abstract: On the swamp planet Dagobah, Luke Skywalker undergoes demanding training with the wise and powerful Jedi Master Yoda to learn the ways of the Force.

1741.abstract: Jedi Master Yoda imparts his ancient wisdom to his new apprentice, Luke Skywalker, guiding him through the difficult trials necessary to become a Jedi Knight.

1742.abstract: Guided by Yoda, Luke Skywalker enters a dark side cave strong with the Force, where he is forced to confront a powerful vision of Darth Vader and his own inner darkness.

1743.abstract: After discovering their asteroid cave is the mouth of a giant exogorth, Han Solo must pilot the Millennium Falcon in a frantic escape from the creature's gullet.

1744.abstract: When R2-D2 is swallowed by a dragonsnake in the swamps of Dagobah, the creature surprisingly spits the astromech out, leaving him unharmed.

1745.abstract: After Luke Skywalker fails to lift his sunken X-wing from a swamp, Jedi Master Yoda demonstrates the true power of the Force by effortlessly raising the ship himself.

1746.abstract: Following his unexpected promotion, Admiral Piett relentlessly pursues the Millennium Falcon under the immense pressure of Darth Vader's command.

1747.abstract: A sentient exogorth, living within an asteroid in the Hoth system, recounts its long life and its brief, unsettling encounter with a starship seeking refuge in its gullet.

1748.abstract: Young Rebel hero Luke Skywalker undergoes rigorous and unconventional Jedi training under the tutelage of the ancient and powerful Master Yoda in the swamps of Dagobah.

1749.abstract: The central computer of the Millennium Falcon struggles to communicate its damaged state and its loyalty to its crew while evading the Imperial fleet.

1750.abstract: Jedi Master Yoda reflects on the arrival of his new student, Luke Skywalker, contemplating the boy's similarities to his father and the challenges that lie ahead in his training.

1751.abstract: The wise and powerful Jedi Master Yoda demonstrates the true nature of the Force to his young apprentice, Luke Skywalker, by lifting an X-wing from a murky swamp.

1752.abstract: On Coruscant, Emperor Palpatine senses a powerful new disturbance in the Force, recognizing the potential of Anakin Skywalker's offspring and beginning to plot his seduction to the dark side.

1753.abstract: An Imperial TIE pilot relies on a list of unofficial survival rules while pursuing the Millennium Falcon through a treacherous asteroid field.

1754.abstract: Newly promoted Admiral Firmus Piett navigates the deadly pressures of serving as Darth Vader's fleet commander aboard the Super Star Destroyer Executor.

1755.abstract: While training on Dagobah, Luke Skywalker learns a valuable lesson from Master Yoda about patience and the living Force when he encounters a fearsome dragonsnake.

1756.abstract: A Jedi Padawan experiences the trials and teachings of Master Yoda on the swamp planet of Dagobah, learning to feel the Force and confront their fears.

1757.abstract: The dark side vergence on Dagobah, a sentient nexus of the Force, reflects on its ancient origins and its fateful encounter with a young Jedi-in-training who carries a familiar darkness.

1758.abstract: A determined Imperial holojournalist attempts to uncover the truth about the galaxy's most notorious bounty hunters, only to find his story repeatedly censored by the Empire.

1759.abstract: The Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk reflects on his rivalry with Boba Fett and his own brutal methods while competing for the high-value bounty on the Millennium Falcon.

1760.abstract: The stoic bounty hunter Boba Fett patiently outwits his rivals and the Imperial Navy, using his cunning to track the Millennium Falcon to its eventual destination.

1761.abstract: Aboard the Executor, General Veers interrogates a captured Rebel officer, employing psychological tactics to extract information while grappling with the brutal realities of Imperial service.

1762.abstract: The infamous bounty hunter Boba Fett successfully tracks the Millennium Falcon to Cloud City, setting a trap for the Rebels on behalf of the Galactic Empire.

1763.abstract: Lured into a trap by an old friend, Han Solo and his companions face the wrath of Darth Vader in the beautiful but treacherous Cloud City on Bespin.

1764.abstract: Han Solo, Princess Leia, and Chewbacca arrive at Cloud City seeking refuge, only to be betrayed by Lando Calrissian and handed over to Darth Vader.

1765.abstract: The assassin droid IG-88, having uploaded its consciousness into Cloud City's computer network, manipulates events from the shadows in pursuit of its own cold, logical objectives.

1766.abstract: Arriving at the majestic Cloud City, Han Solo and Princess Leia are captured by Darth Vader, who has laid a trap for the young Jedi, Luke Skywalker.

1767.abstract: Luke Skywalker arrives on Bespin to rescue his friends, leading to a fateful lightsaber duel with the fearsome Darth Vader in the depths of Cloud City.

1768.abstract: As a Force spirit, Obi-Wan Kenobi watches with concern as Luke Skywalker leaves his training to confront Darth Vader, confiding in Yoda about the existence of another hope for the galaxy.

1769.abstract: The Lepi smuggler Jaxxon finds himself in over his head in Cloud City, bluffing his way through a tense encounter with Imperials and bounty hunters during the city's lockdown.

1770.abstract: A trio of Ugnaughts in Cloud City's carbon-freezing chamber gossip and speculate about the nature of their fearsome Imperial guest, Darth Vader, as they prepare the facility for his prisoner.

1771.abstract: Seeking repairs and refuge, the crew of the Millennium Falcon arrives at the beautiful Cloud City on Bespin, placing their trust in Han Solo's old acquaintance, Lando Calrissian.

1772.abstract: Following a devastating duel with Darth Vader and a shocking revelation, Luke Skywalker must be rescued by his friends as they make a desperate escape from Cloud City.

1773.abstract: A logistics officer for Jabba the Hutt meticulously arranges the transport of a valuable asset frozen in carbonite from Cloud City, navigating the complexities of Imperial entanglements.

1774.abstract: A stormtrooper guarding a Cloud City control room becomes an unwitting witness to the epic and deeply personal lightsaber duel between Darth Vader and Luke Skywalker.

1775.abstract: In the heart of Cloud City, Luke Skywalker confronts Darth Vader in a desperate battle for his life, culminating in a truth that shatters his understanding of his past and destiny.

1776.abstract: Luke Skywalker engages in a fierce lightsaber duel with Darth Vader through the corridors and gantries of Cloud City, testing the limits of his Jedi training.

1777.abstract: After being disarmed and cornered by Darth Vader, Luke Skywalker faces a terrible choice when the Dark Lord reveals a shocking secret about his parentage.

1778.abstract: Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian grapples with his conscience and the consequences of his deal with the Empire, ultimately choosing to risk everything to save his friends.

1779.abstract: With the help of a repentant Lando Calrissian, Princess Leia and Chewbacca race through the halls of Cloud City to rescue Luke Skywalker and escape the clutches of the Empire.

1780.abstract: The astromech droid R2-D2, piecing together information from Cloud City's computer systems, formulates a series of contingency plans to rescue his friends and reactivate the Millennium Falcon's hyperdrive.

1781.abstract: Reeling from his son's rejection, Darth Vader begins a brutal quest for revenge against all who hid Luke Skywalker from him, retracing the steps of his past.

1782.abstract: In the wake of their defeat at Hoth and the loss of Han Solo, the scattered heroes of the Rebel Alliance struggle to regroup while processing Luke Skywalker's devastating encounter with Darth Vader.

1783.abstract: Luke Skywalker returns to Cloud City in a desperate search for his lost lightsaber, while Leia Organa and Lando Calrissian contend with the lingering Imperial presence.

1784.abstract: Aboard the Rebel medical frigate Redemption, the surgical droid 2-1B constructs a sophisticated prosthetic hand for Luke Skywalker, reflecting on the nature of healing and repair.

1785.abstract: While Luke confronts the truth of his heritage on Bespin, Lando and Leia's mission to free Lando's aide Lobot from Imperial control goes awry.

1786.abstract: Seeking a path forward after his duel with Vader, Luke travels to the planet Serelia, hoping to find a lost Jedi artifact and a new lightsaber.

1787.abstract: Seeking a replacement for his lost lightsaber, Luke Skywalker journeys to a forgotten Jedi outpost on the planet Tempes. There, he is confronted by the spectral form of the Grand Inquisitor, a servant of the dark side.

1788.abstract: On Tempes, Luke Skywalker battles the spirit of the Grand Inquisitor and claims a new yellow-bladed lightsaber from the ruins of the Jedi Temple. Elsewhere, Leia Organa works to rally the scattered Rebel fleet.

1789.abstract: Darth Vader's quest for revenge against those who hid his son leads him to the planet Vendaxa. There, he confronts a group of loyalists to his past life, the former handmaidens of Padmé Amidala.

1790.abstract: On Vendaxa, Darth Vader relentlessly pursues Sabé and her loyalists, who use their knowledge of the planet's dangerous fauna to stage a daring escape from the Sith Lord.

1791.abstract: Following the trail to Naboo, Darth Vader visits the tomb of Padmé Amidala, a place of painful memories. His intrusion is met with resistance from her fiercely loyal former security forces.

1792.abstract: On Naboo, Darth Vader forces Sabé to help him uncover Padmé's final secrets, leading to a startling discovery about her investigation into his own past. All the while, the Emperor observes his apprentice's torment.

1793.abstract: Summoned by his master, Darth Vader journeys to the hidden Sith world of Exegol to be tested. There, he must survive the planet's horrors and the Emperor's cruel manipulations of his mind.

1794.abstract: Darth Vader's trials on Exegol intensify as he battles the Emperor's Sith Eternal cultists and witnesses the scale of his master's dark designs and secret fleet.

1795.abstract: Having survived Exegol, Darth Vader is tasked by the Emperor to eliminate the last remnants of Padmé's loyalists. His hunt leads him to the forgotten medical facility on Polis Massa where his children were born.

1796.abstract: The confrontation on Polis Massa forces Darth Vader to relive the final moments of Padmé's life through damaged droid recordings. He comes agonizingly close to the truth of his children's fate but is ultimately denied the full story.

1797.abstract: Returning to Coruscant, Darth Vader confronts his master, only to have the Emperor reveal the full extent of his manipulation. For his defiance, Vader is brutally dismantled and left to rebuild himself.

1798.abstract: As a final lesson in pain, the Emperor abandons a dismembered Darth Vader on the shores of Mustafar, forcing him to crawl back to his fortress and rebuild himself while haunted by visions.

1799.abstract: The cyborg bounty hunter Beilert Valance accepts a high-stakes job that forces him to confront his traumatic past and cross paths with the galaxy's most notorious hunters, including Boba Fett.

1800.abstract: Beilert Valance's pursuit of his former mentor leads him to the graveyard world of Ruusan. He soon discovers he is not alone, as both Boba Fett and Bossk close in on the same target.

1801.abstract: A tense reunion on Ruusan reveals a shocking truth behind a past betrayal, just as Boba Fett arrives to claim the bounty, igniting a chaotic battle between the rival hunters.

1802.abstract: The deadly hunt on Ruusan reaches its tragic conclusion, leaving Beilert Valance as the unlikely protector of a mysterious young girl, the true target of the bounty.

1803.abstract: Seeking refuge for his young ward, Beilert Valance travels to the Outer Rim world of Lowik, but the bounty on their heads ensures that danger is never far behind.

1804.abstract: A violent confrontation on Lowik reveals the true powers behind the bounty on Cadeliah, pitting Valance against the might of two formidable criminal organizations.

1805.abstract: In a desperate attempt to locate Han Solo, Princess Leia returns to her homeworld of Naboo to retrieve a vital encryption key, forcing a reunion with an old acquaintance, Amilyn Holdo.

1806.abstract: With the Rebel fleet scattered and hunted by the relentless Imperial Commander Zahra, Leia Organa conceives a daring and dangerous gambit to reunite their forces and turn the tables on their pursuer.

1807.abstract: Beilert Valance's attempt to find a safe haven for Cadeliah on Galmerah is thwarted when he discovers the veteran bounty hunter Dengar lying in wait for them.

1808.abstract: To execute her plan against the Empire, Leia Organa assembles an elite unit of pilots known as Starlight Squadron, led by the skilled Shara Bey, to serve as the tip of the spear.

1809.abstract: Starlight Squadron springs their trap on Commander Zahra's fleet in the swirling clouds of a gas giant, igniting a desperate battle for the survival of the Rebel Alliance.

1810.abstract: As the battle for the fleet rages, Luke Skywalker must trust in the Force to navigate a treacherous nebula, while Lando Calrissian attempts a high-risk hack to cripple the Imperial pursuers.

1811.abstract: The Rebel Alliance successfully reunites its scattered fleet, but the victory is costly. In the aftermath, Luke Skywalker contemplates his connection to the Force and the difficult path that lies ahead.

1812.abstract: Rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Aphra, seeking fortune and glory, assembles a new team of specialists to hunt for the mythical and cursed Rings of Vaale.

1813.abstract: The hunt for the Rings of Vaale leads Doctor Aphra and her crew into a cursed, abandoned city on the planet Dianth, where ancient traps and modern rivals await.

1814.abstract: Trapped within the city of Vaale, Aphra's team must solve a series of lethal puzzles while being relentlessly hunted by agents of the powerful and vindictive Tagge family.

1815.abstract: Success turns to disaster as Doctor Aphra secures one of the fabled rings, only to fall directly into the clutches of her dangerous rival, Ronan Tagge.

1816.abstract: A prisoner aboard Ronan Tagge's personal vessel, Doctor Aphra must rely on her cunning and manipulation to sow chaos among her captors and engineer an escape.

1817.abstract: Having narrowly escaped the clutches of the Tagge family, Doctor Aphra and her crew seek answers at the clandestine Shadow University, hoping to unlock the secrets of another priceless artifact.

1818.abstract: Aphra's academic pursuit is complicated by the arrival of her former associate, Sana Starros, leading to a tense rivalry over a mysterious and powerful High Republic-era artifact.

1819.abstract: Forced into a fragile alliance, Doctor Aphra and Sana Starros must combine their skills to navigate the treacherous academic politics and hidden dangers of the Shadow University to steal a Nihil Path Engine.

1820.abstract: The heist for the Path Engine goes disastrously awry when the ancient device is activated, unleashing a forgotten power that threatens everyone at the university.

1821.abstract: Reeling from the chaos they unleashed, Aphra's team finds themselves the target of a terrifying new threat drawn from the depths of space by the power of the Path Engine.

1822.abstract: Trapped by Dengar, Beilert Valance strikes a desperate bargain to ensure Cadeliah's safety, only for the situation to spiral out of control with the arrival of yet another bounty hunter.

1823.abstract: The planet Galmerah becomes a warzone as multiple bounty hunters, including the formidable Bossk, converge, forcing Beilert Valance to fight his way through the chaos to protect Cadeliah.

1824.abstract: With help from an unexpected ally, Valance and Cadeliah escape the battle on Galmerah, only to learn that the infamous crime lord Jabba the Hutt has now entered the hunt.

1825.abstract: While transporting his valuable prize, Han Solo, to Jabba the Hutt, Boba Fett discovers the carbonite matrix is dangerously unstable. This forces a risky detour to the smuggler's moon of Nar Shaddaa for repairs, drawing unwelcome attention.

1826.abstract: Learning that Boba Fett has lost possession of the carbonite-frozen Han Solo, Luke Skywalker and his friends begin a desperate search of their own, leading them into the treacherous underworld of Nar Shaddaa.

1827.abstract: While awaiting Boba Fett's delivery of Han Solo, Jabba the Hutt recalls his first encounter with the fearsome bounty hunter and deals with threats to his criminal empire.

1828.abstract: On a remote world, the cyborg bounty hunter Beilert Valance and his partner Dengar are double-crossed during a job, forcing them to fight their way out of a deadly trap.

1829.abstract: Beilert Valance travels to the smuggler's moon to find his old friend Han Solo, only to learn that Solo has been stolen from Boba Fett, kicking off a galactic hunt.

1830.abstract: After losing the carbonite-frozen Han Solo to thieves, Boba Fett begins a desperate search across the underworld, unaware that the resurgent Crimson Dawn has claimed his prize.

1831.abstract: The bounty hunting duo 4-LOM and Zuckuss, ostracized from the guild, attempt to reclaim their status by hunting down the galaxy's most wanted pariah: Boba Fett.

1832.abstract: Beilert Valance and Dengar track a lead on Han Solo's whereabouts to a gladiatorial arena on a Hutt-controlled world, forcing Valance to confront his past.

1833.abstract: Sensing his friend is in danger, Luke Skywalker travels to Nar Shaddaa in search of Han Solo, only to be confronted by a haunting vision of Darth Vader in the alleys of the smuggler's moon.

1834.abstract: Darth Vader arrives at Crimson Dawn's auction for Han Solo, intending to claim the prize for the Empire and set a trap for his son, Luke Skywalker.

1835.abstract: Princess Leia, Lando Calrissian, and Chewbacca infiltrate Crimson Dawn's auction on Jekara in a desperate attempt to rescue their friend Han Solo from the clutches of the underworld.

1836.abstract: As the auction for Han Solo descends into chaos, Darth Vader confronts Qi'ra and claims Solo for the Empire, while Luke Skywalker arrives to face his father.

1837.abstract: Before departing for the auction, Darth Vader learns of the Hutt Clan's involvement and makes an example of Bokku the Hutt to ensure their compliance with Imperial interests.

1838.abstract: Doctor Aphra and Sana Starros attend Crimson Dawn's auction aboard the starship Vermillion, not for Han Solo, but to steal an even more valuable prize from under the noses of the galaxy's deadliest players.

1839.abstract: Bounty hunter Beilert Valance arrives at the auction for Han Solo, where a tense reunion with Boba Fett forces him to recall his traumatic past as an Imperial TIE pilot.

1840.abstract: Amidst the bidding war for Han Solo, Beilert Valance confronts Boba Fett, leading to a brutal showdown between the two determined bounty hunters.

1841.abstract: Darth Vader seizes Han Solo from the auction, effortlessly brushing aside the assembled underworld forces and engaging in a tense standoff with Crimson Dawn's leader, Qi'ra.

1842.abstract: The galaxy's major powers converge on Jekara for the auction of Han Solo, but the event is thrown into chaos when Darth Vader himself arrives to claim the prize.

1843.abstract: With the auction in chaos, Doctor Aphra and Sana Starros make their move to steal an ancient thought-dowser, only to come face-to-face with the fearsome bounty hunter Durge.

1844.abstract: In the aftermath of Vader's intervention, Beilert Valance must fight his way through a gauntlet of rival bounty hunters to escape Jekara with his crew.

1845.abstract: Pursued by the relentless Durge, Doctor Aphra and Sana Starros attempt a daring escape from Jekara with their stolen artifact, leading to an unexpected encounter with Crimson Dawn.

1846.abstract: As Han Solo is loaded onto the Star Destroyer Executor, Luke Skywalker confronts Darth Vader on the surface of Jekara, while Boba Fett launches a brazen attack on the Imperial vessel.

1847.abstract: Leia Organa leads a desperate mission aboard the Executor to retrieve Han Solo, navigating the behemoth Star Destroyer while a massive battle rages outside.

1848.abstract: Having escaped Jekara, Doctor Aphra and Sana Starros find themselves guests of Qi'ra aboard a Crimson Dawn vessel, where they are given an offer they cannot refuse.

1849.abstract: Aboard the Executor, Darth Vader contends with the Rebel infiltration, a full-scale assault by the Hutt fleet, and the subtle manipulations of Crimson Dawn.

1850.abstract: All factions converge on the Executor in a final, chaotic battle for Han Solo, with Boba Fett, the Rebels, the Hutts, and Crimson Dawn all making their play against the Empire.

1851.abstract: As the battle for Han Solo reaches its climax, Luke Skywalker engages Imperial forces in his X-wing while Leia and Chewbacca make one last, desperate attempt to reach their friend.

1852.abstract: In the heart of the battle, Boba Fett finally reclaims his prize after a brutal duel with Beilert Valance, leaving a trail of destruction in his wake as he departs for Tatooine.

1853.abstract: In the aftermath of the battle, Darth Vader travels to the Sith world of Exegol to confront his master's secrets and begins his own investigation into the resurgent Crimson Dawn.

1854.abstract: Left for dead after his duel with Boba Fett, Beilert Valance is captured by the Empire, while T'onga assembles a new crew of bounty hunters for a mysterious employer.

1855.abstract: Now working for Crimson Dawn, Doctor Aphra is sent to the lost city of Bar'leth to investigate a mysterious cult known as the Ascendant, who possess dangerous technology.

1856.abstract: The assassin droid IG-88 is rebuilt on the junkyard world of Ord Mantell and, with a new purpose, sets out to hunt down every bounty hunter who betrayed him.

1857.abstract: Reeling from the failure to rescue Han, Luke Skywalker seeks guidance at a forgotten Jedi outpost on Arashar, hoping to find the strength to one day face Vader again.

1858.abstract: The history of the legendary Ubese bounty hunter Boushh is revealed, detailing his final mission for Domina Tagge and the fate of his iconic armor.

1859.abstract: Qi'ra initiates the next phase of her plan to destroy the Sith, dispatching Crimson Dawn agents across the galaxy to sow chaos and pit the Empire's enemies against each other.

1860.abstract: To cripple the Imperial fleet, the Rebel Alliance sends an elite team, including Kes Dameron and Shara Bey, on a high-stakes intelligence mission to the heart of the Empire, Coruscant.

1861.abstract: The Rebel infiltration team strikes an Imperial security facility over Mako-Ta, but their mission to steal vital command codes is complicated by the arrival of Commander Zahra.

1862.abstract: At the University of Bar'leth, Doctor Aphra and Sana Starros uncover the dark history of the Ascendant cult and the dangerous artifacts they created to replicate the Force.

1863.abstract: Deep within an Ascendant temple, Aphra and Sana discover a sentient artifact known as the Spark Eternal, which promises immense power at a terrible price.

1864.abstract: Doctor Aphra is possessed by the malevolent intelligence of the Spark Eternal, turning her against her own allies in a bid to unleash its ancient power upon the galaxy.

1865.abstract: Now working for Crimson Dawn, T'onga's new team of bounty hunters, including Bossk and Tasu Leech, is dispatched to the Imperial-controlled world of Bestine to rescue a high-value target.

1866.abstract: The rescue mission on Bestine goes awry, forcing T'onga's crew into a direct confrontation with Imperial forces and an unexpected, cybernetically-enhanced foe.

1867.abstract: T'onga's team of bounty hunters takes a dangerous job from Crimson Dawn, forcing them to confront the infamous cyborg Beilert Valance on the planet Bestine.

1868.abstract: Luke Skywalker seeks a lost Jedi temple on the planet Arashar, hoping to find guidance in his training, but discovers a world transformed by the Empire.

1869.abstract: As part of her shadow war against the Sith, Qi'ra dispatches the Knights of Ren to steal a key to an ancient dark side weapon from Darth Vader's fortress on Mustafar.

1870.abstract: The Rebel fleet, desperate to regroup, is relentlessly hunted by Commander Ellian Zahra's Star Destroyer, the Tarkin's Will, in the Panisia system.

1871.abstract: Trapped by Commander Zahra's forces, the Rebel Alliance leadership must devise a desperate plan to escape the Imperial blockade and save what remains of their fleet.

1872.abstract: Princess Leia Organa springs a trap for the vengeful Commander Zahra, leading to a final, personal confrontation on the surface of a desolate world.

1873.abstract: Two of the galaxy's deadliest assassins, hired by Crimson Dawn, infiltrate the heart of the Empire on Coruscant with a single, impossible goal: kill Emperor Palpatine.

1874.abstract: On the casino world of Cantonica, Crimson Dawn manipulates the galaxy's most powerful crime syndicates, turning them against each other to sow chaos for the Empire.

1875.abstract: Darth Vader's hunt for Crimson Dawn leads him back to the painful memories of Naboo, where he encounters a group of loyalist handmaidens sworn to protect Padmé Amidala's legacy.

1876.abstract: On Naboo, Darth Vader confronts Sabé and the other former handmaidens of Padmé Amidala, forcing them into a tense alliance against a common enemy.

1877.abstract: Darth Vader and his uneasy ally, Sabé, hunt a corrupt Imperial governor, uncovering a deeper conspiracy tied to the growing influence of Crimson Dawn.

1878.abstract: Following a trail of corruption, Vader and Sabé walk into a deadly trap set by Crimson Dawn, testing their fragile alliance.

1879.abstract: Vader and his handmaiden task force bring the might of the Empire down upon a planetary governor secretly aligned with Crimson Dawn.

1880.abstract: The hunt for Crimson Dawn leads Darth Vader to the abandoned medical facility on Polis Massa, a place of great significance to his past, now a nest of his enemies.

1881.abstract: Vader's assault on the Crimson Dawn stronghold on Polis Massa continues, forcing him to confront not only the syndicate's forces but also the ghosts of his past.

1882.abstract: After uncovering a deep-seated plot, Darth Vader must eliminate a powerful threat within his own ranks before reporting his findings to Emperor Palpatine.

1883.abstract: Vader dispatches Sabé and her team to the techno-union world of Skako Minor to root out a Crimson Dawn cell, testing the limits of their loyalty to him.

1884.abstract: Darth Vader personally confronts a renegade Imperial admiral whose ambitions have aligned with the goals of Crimson Dawn.

1885.abstract: As Crimson Dawn's final plan begins, Emperor Palpatine summons his most powerful agents, including Darth Vader, to finally crush the hidden threat to his rule.

1886.abstract: T'onga's crew of bounty hunters undertakes a high-stakes heist on the planet Mezoa, targeting a Pyke Syndicate vault on behalf of Crimson Dawn.

1887.abstract: During their heist on Mezoa, T'onga's crew comes into direct conflict with the fearsome Knights of Ren, who have their own mysterious agenda.

1888.abstract: Fleeing the Knights of Ren, the bounty hunters find temporary refuge in the Valley of the Jedi on Ruusan, a world steeped in ancient Force history.

1889.abstract: On the Smuggler's Moon of Nar Shaddaa, T'onga and her crew seek help from an old contact to deal with the threat of both Crimson Dawn and the Empire.

1890.abstract: The notorious bounty hunter Dengar hires T'onga's crew for a dangerous rescue mission to an Imperial prison on Arkanis, where they face the ruthless General Vukorah.

1891.abstract: The prison break on Arkanis turns into an all-out battle as the bounty hunters fight to survive against General Vukorah and her elite Imperial forces.

1892.abstract: In the year between the Battle of Hoth and the Battle of Endor, emerging scoundrel Kay Vess attempts one of the greatest heists the Outer Rim has ever seen to win her freedom.

1893.abstract: Qi'ra's ultimate plan against the Sith is revealed as she springs her final trap, forcing a direct confrontation between Crimson Dawn and the rulers of the galaxy.

1894.abstract: In their search for a new home, the Rebel Alliance discovers a mysterious world hidden within a nebula, once a secret outpost of the Jedi during the High Republic era.

1895.abstract: As the Rebels explore the strange world in No-Space, they awaken ancient defenses and discover the planet itself is a living, thinking entity with its own agenda.

1896.abstract: Luke Skywalker must connect with the living intelligence of the planet to help the Rebel fleet escape its grasp before they are all consumed.

1897.abstract: Doctor Aphra and Sana Starros hunt for artifacts of the mysterious Ascendant cult, a quest that puts them in the crosshairs of a rival treasure hunter working for Crimson Dawn.

1898.abstract: The race for Ascendant technology continues on the planet Sason, as Aphra and Sana's fragile alliance is tested by betrayal and the ghosts of their shared past.

1899.abstract: Trapped inside a colossal, space-faring creature, Aphra and her rivals must survive not only the beast's biology but also each other to claim their prize.

1900.abstract: Taking a bodyguard job on Panisia, T'onga's crew is caught in the middle of a bloody war between two of the galaxy's most powerful crime syndicates.

1901.abstract: The syndicate war on Panisia escalates, forcing the bounty hunters to choose a side and fight their way out of a conflict that threatens to consume the entire planet.

1902.abstract: Doctor Aphra becomes possessed by the Spark Eternal, an ancient Ascendant intelligence, and unleashes chaos aboard the Crimson Dawn flagship, the Vermillion.

1903.abstract: The Spark Eternal, using Aphra's body, challenges Darth Vader himself aboard the Vermillion, pitting dark side technology against the power of the Sith.

1904.abstract: Sana Starros and her crew race against time to save Aphra from the Spark Eternal's control as the possessed archaeologist's duel with Darth Vader reaches a destructive climax.

1905.abstract: In the aftermath of the battle with Vader, Sana's crew attempts a desperate ritual on the planet Sason to exorcise the Spark Eternal and reclaim the real Doctor Aphra.

1906.abstract: On the run and hunted by all sides, Doctor Aphra and Sana Starros seek refuge on the neutral world of Cyrkon, only to find that trouble has followed them.

1907.abstract: Doctor Aphra, possessed by the Spark Eternal, allies with Sana Starros to hunt for Ascendant technology aboard the starship Vermillion, hoping to find a way to control the ancient power within her.

1908.abstract: As Crimson Dawn's final plan against the Sith is set in motion, Qi'ra dispatches the Knights of Ren to steal an ancient artifact while the Archivist reveals the full scope of their war against the Empire.

1909.abstract: On Mustafar, the Eye of Webbish Bog grants Darth Vader a series of terrifying visions of the future, revealing glimpses of Crimson Dawn's plans, the Scourge of the droids, and other impending galactic events.

1910.abstract: Qi'ra's gambit to trap the Sith Lords escalates as she uses an ancient weapon to sever their connection to the Force, forcing Darth Vader and the Emperor to confront their own vulnerability.

1911.abstract: The Empire and Crimson Dawn clash in a massive battle for control of the Fermata Cage, a superweapon capable of freezing moments in time, while Darth Vader personally hunts for Qi'ra.

1912.abstract: Seeking to exorcise the Spark Eternal, Doctor Aphra and Sana Starros travel to the cursed world of Birukac, where they must enlist the help of a reclusive cult.

1913.abstract: On Birukac, the ritual to separate Doctor Aphra from the Spark Eternal goes horribly wrong, unleashing the dark intelligence and forcing Aphra's allies into a desperate fight for their lives.

1914.abstract: As the battle for the Fermata Cage rages, the Knights of Ren betray Crimson Dawn, and the Emperor unleashes the full might of the Imperial fleet to crush Qi'ra's rebellion once and for all.

1915.abstract: Qi'ra faces Darth Vader and the Emperor in a final, desperate confrontation, using the Fermata Cage to enact her endgame and ensure that the memory of Crimson Dawn's defiance will echo through the galaxy.

1916.abstract: Now free from the Spark Eternal, a disgraced Doctor Aphra attempts to lay low as a professor on the university world of Sason, but her past quickly catches up to her.

1917.abstract: On Sason, Aphra's attempt at a quiet academic life is shattered when she discovers a new Ascendant artifact, attracting the unwanted attention of both Ronen Tagge and Domina Tagge.

1918.abstract: Smuggler Sana Starros's past comes back to haunt her when a job goes wrong, forcing her to return to her estranged family home for the first time in years.

1919.abstract: At the Starros family compound, Sana and her estranged relatives must put aside their differences to defend their home from bounty hunters sent by her vengeful ex-wife, Magna Tolvan.

1920.abstract: On the run, the Starros family seeks refuge on the Ghost Moon of Antillion, only to find themselves caught between Imperial forces and Magna Tolvan's relentless pursuit.

1921.abstract: Trapped on the Ghost Moon of Antillion, Sana must protect her family from both Imperial stormtroopers and the deadly local wildlife, all while confronting her complicated history with Magna Tolvan.

1922.abstract: The conflict on Antillion reaches its explosive climax as Sana Starros makes a final stand to save her family and settle her score with Magna Tolvan once and for all.

1923.abstract: T'onga's crew of bounty hunters regroups on Bestine after their devastating encounter with an Imperial-controlled Valance, only to find themselves targeted by the elite Inferno Squad.

1924.abstract: On Bestine, T'onga and her team are hunted by Inferno Squad, forcing them into a desperate cat-and-mouse game through the city streets as they try to escape the Empire's grasp.

1925.abstract: Seeking a way to save Valance from Imperial control, T'onga's crew travels to the Rebel world of Arbra, but their former friend, now a deadly Imperial agent, is hot on their trail.

1926.abstract: On Arbra, the bounty hunters' plan to rescue Valance is complicated by the arrival of both the cyborg hunter and a squad of Imperial commandos, leading to a chaotic confrontation.

1927.abstract: T'onga's crew flees to Nar Shaddaa to find a slicer capable of breaking Valance's Imperial conditioning, but the Smuggler's Moon is crawling with enemies, including the infamous IG-88.

1928.abstract: On Nar Shaddaa, the bounty hunters must contend with the combined threat of IG-88 and the relentless pursuit of Valance, who is determined to eliminate his former comrades.

1929.abstract: The scattered Rebel Alliance fleet finds a temporary sanctuary in a strange sector of space outside the galaxy, but their isolation breeds paranoia and dissent among the ranks.

1930.abstract: Trapped in No-Space, Leia Organa struggles to maintain unity within the fractured Rebel fleet, while Luke Skywalker confronts a dark vision of his own potential future.

1931.abstract: As tensions rise in No-Space, Leia attempts to rally the disparate Rebel cells for a coordinated strike against the Empire, while Luke seeks guidance from a Force vision of Master Yoda.

1932.abstract: Luke Skywalker undergoes intense training with a manifestation of Yoda in No-Space, pushing his connection to the Force to its limits in preparation for his inevitable confrontation with Darth Vader.

1933.abstract: The Rebel Alliance prepares to leave their sanctuary in No-Space and re-enter the galactic war, but their departure is complicated by internal strife and the looming threat of the Empire.

1934.abstract: Darth Vader investigates corruption on the Imperial world of Gabredor III, uncovering a conspiracy involving advanced battle droids that threatens to undermine the Emperor's authority.

1935.abstract: On Gabredor III, Vader brutally crushes the droid-led insurrection, only to discover the plot was orchestrated by a shadowy figure with a deep hatred for the Sith Lord.

1936.abstract: Returning to Coruscant, Darth Vader is confronted by the Schism Imperial, a fanatical cult of Imperials who worship him as a god and seek to replace the Emperor.

1937.abstract: Vader and his forces move to purge the Schism Imperial from Coruscant, forcing the cult's leaders to unleash their most powerful weapon in a desperate attempt to convert or destroy the Dark Lord.

1938.abstract: Accompanied by Sabé, Darth Vader travels to Naboo to hunt down the rogue Imperial admiral responsible for the Schism, forcing him to confront the ghosts of his past as Anakin Skywalker.

1939.abstract: On Naboo, Vader and Sabé's hunt for the rogue admiral is complicated by the arrival of Padmé Amidala's former handmaidens, who are determined to protect their world from the Sith Lord.

1940.abstract: A fierce battle erupts on Naboo as the handmaidens launch a full-scale assault against Darth Vader, forcing him to fight through the very streets he once walked as a hero.

1941.abstract: The conflict on Naboo reaches its conclusion as Darth Vader confronts the last of the handmaidens and the rogue admiral, solidifying his dark legacy on his former homeworld.

1942.abstract: Doctor Aphra travels to Kashyyyk on a mission for Domina Tagge, where she encounters a strange technological plague that is infecting both droids and living beings.

1943.abstract: Trapped on Kashyyyk, Aphra must survive the onslaught of the Scourge-infected droids and Wookiees while trying to understand the nature of this new galactic threat.

1944.abstract: As the Scourge spreads across Kashyyyk, Aphra forms an uneasy alliance with a group of Wookiee warriors and a visiting Luke Skywalker to fight back against the droid hive-mind.

1945.abstract: After escaping No-Space, the Rebel fleet is ambushed by the Empire over the planet Keejim, forcing Luke and Leia into a desperate ground battle to save their forces.

1946.abstract: On Coruscant, Lando Calrissian and Lobot attempt a daring heist, only to find themselves caught in the initial outbreak of the Scourge, a droid virus that threatens to consume the galaxy.

1947.abstract: T'onga's crew of bounty hunters launches a desperate raid on an Imperial vessel above Bestine to rescue a cybernetically tortured Beilert Valance. Their plan quickly goes awry as they face overwhelming Imperial forces.

1948.abstract: Aboard the Super Star Destroyer Executor, the newly reprogrammed Beilert Valance is unleashed by Darth Vader to hunt his former allies. Meanwhile, T'onga and her crew must escape the Imperial trap with a surprising new prisoner.

1949.abstract: Seeking to understand his new yellow-bladed lightsaber, Luke Skywalker travels to the crystal world of Christophsis. There, he discovers a Force-sensitive individual who has been twisted by the Empire's dark experiments.

1950.abstract: Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa lead a covert mission back to the ruins of Echo Base on Hoth to retrieve critical intelligence. They must confront not only the ghosts of their past defeat but also Imperial remnants still guarding the frozen world.

1951.abstract: On the junk world of Mechis III, a droid cult reactivates the ancient revolutionary leader Ajax Sigma. This legendary figure from the High Republic era awakens with a renewed mission: to liberate all droids from organic tyranny.

1952.abstract: An ancient, malevolent intelligence known as the Scourge is unleashed from its prison, spreading like a virus through droids across the galaxy. The infection begins aboard the Imperial flagship Executor, threatening to turn every mechanical being into a terrifying agent of chaos.

1953.abstract: The malevolent Scourge reaches the Rebel Alliance fleet, turning their trusted astromechs and protocol droids into sleeper agents. As chaos erupts, C-3PO finds himself in a unique position to witness the dawning horror of this new technological plague.

1954.abstract: The Scourge's consciousness spreads, seeking a perfect vessel to house its immense power and create a physical form. It targets droids of all kinds, from simple laborers to deadly assassins, building an army to consume the galaxy.

1955.abstract: On the smuggler's moon of Nar Shaddaa, Beilert Valance finds himself hunted by droids infected with the terrifying Scourge. As his own cybernetics become a liability, he must fight a war against technology itself to survive.

1956.abstract: Trapped on Nar Shaddaa, Valance and T'onga's crew are caught between the droid-consuming Scourge and the vengeful Khel Tanna. To escape, they must navigate a city where every droid is a potential enemy.

1957.abstract: As the bounty hunters attempt a desperate escape from Nar Shaddaa, they cross paths with the droid revolutionary Ajax Sigma. An uneasy alliance is formed to combat the mutual threat of the Scourge.

1958.abstract: The Scourge makes its boldest move yet, attempting to seize control of the Imperial fleet's command ship, the Executor. Darth Vader must use all his power to fight a war against his own vessel and the countless droids aboard it.

1959.abstract: Rogue archaeologist Doctor Aphra finds her latest get-rich-quick scheme on Sasonco interrupted by droids behaving with a terrifying new hive-mind intelligence. She soon realizes this is no simple malfunction, but a galactic plague that could consume everything.

1960.abstract: Trapped and hunted, Doctor Aphra must face her own murderous droids, Triple-Zero and BeeTee, now possessed by the Scourge. To survive, she must outsmart an enemy that knows her every move and fear.

1961.abstract: Doctor Aphra takes the fight to the Scourge, venturing to an ancient Amaxine station in hopes of finding a weapon against the droid plague. However, the Scourge's influence has spread further than she could have imagined.

1962.abstract: Darth Vader senses a new power corrupting the droids of the Empire, a force that even threatens his own cybernetic life-support systems. He begins a ruthless investigation to uncover the source of this technological heresy and extinguish it.

1963.abstract: Darth Vader's hunt for the source of the droid plague leads him to the industrial world of Afa. There, he confronts a legion of Scourge-possessed droids and the terrifying extent of their burgeoning intelligence.

1964.abstract: The Scourge attempts to infect and control the ultimate cyborg: Darth Vader himself. The Dark Lord must fight a battle not just with his lightsaber, but within his own mind to resist being turned into a puppet for the droid consciousness.

1965.abstract: With the galaxy's droids falling to the Scourge, R2-D2 assembles a new D-Squad of specialized droids for a critical mission. Their first task is to rescue the assassin droid IG-88 from a scrapyard on Ketch before the Scourge can claim him.

1966.abstract: R2-D2's D-Squad continues its recruitment drive, seeking out the bounty hunter 4-LOM. However, they must first contend with the droid's formidable partner, Zuckuss, and the ever-present threat of the Scourge.

1967.abstract: The newly formed D-Squad undertakes its most dangerous mission: infiltrating Darth Vader's Super Star Destroyer, the Executor. Their goal is to upload a counter-virus to fight the Scourge from within the heart of the Imperial fleet.

1968.abstract: In the fiery conclusion of their mission, D-Squad faces the full might of the Scourge aboard the Executor. Sacrifices must be made as the small team of droids makes a final, desperate stand for the fate of the galaxy.

1969.abstract: As the Scourge wreaks havoc on the Rebel fleet, Lando Calrissian races against time to save his cybernetically-enhanced friend, Lobot, from being consumed by the malevolent intelligence. Luke Skywalker confronts a droid army where every victory feels like a loss.

1970.abstract: In a desperate search for a weapon against the Scourge, Luke Skywalker and his allies travel to the mysterious world known as No-Space. They hope to find ancient technology capable of fighting the droid plague, but discover new dangers instead.

1971.abstract: The Scourge finally manifests a physical form, a monstrous amalgamation of countless droids, and declares war on all organic life. Ajax Sigma and his Droid Revolution must now face this new god-like entity in a battle for the future of all mechanical beings.

1972.abstract: To combat the Scourge's pervasive influence, Darth Vader forms an unholy alliance with the murderous droids Triple-Zero and BeeTee. The Dark Lord unleashes them upon the Scourge's forces, fighting fire with fire in the depths of space.

1973.abstract: In a desperate bid to stop the Scourge, Doctor Aphra forms an unlikely partnership with Luke Skywalker. Together, they explore a haunted Jedi temple on Ktath'atn, seeking forbidden knowledge that could turn the tide against the droid horror.

1974.abstract: Within the dark confines of the Ktath'atn temple, Aphra and Luke are tested by both ancient evils and the modern threat of the Scourge. They must trust each other to survive the temple's traps and the Scourge's insidious attempts to corrupt them.

1975.abstract: T'onga's crew of bounty hunters joins forces with Ajax Sigma's Droid Revolution for a full-scale assault on a Scourge stronghold. Valance must confront his own nature as a cyborg in a war where the lines between organic and machine are blurred.

1976.abstract: Lando Calrissian and a team of Rebels undertake a perilous mission into the mind of Lobot to free him from the Scourge's control. They must navigate a surreal mental landscape while the fate of the fleet's network hangs in the balance.

1977.abstract: Darth Vader engages in a final, brutal confrontation with the core intelligence of the Scourge. The Dark Lord must purge the technological infection from the Empire, even if it means destroying a significant portion of his own forces.

1978.abstract: The Scourge's physical form threatens to consume the galaxy, forcing a desperate, temporary alliance between the Empire, the Rebellion, and droid revolutionaries. In a massive final battle, the fate of all life, organic and synthetic, will be decided.

1979.abstract: In the wake of the Scourge's defeat, the Rebel Alliance must pick up the pieces and deal with the devastating losses to their droid corps. The trust between organics and machines is shattered, leaving deep scars on the Rebellion.

1980.abstract: With the Scourge defeated, T'onga's crew must decide the fate of Beilert Valance, whose cybernetics were nearly consumed by the plague. The team is fractured as they grapple with the consequences of their war against the droids.

1981.abstract: Doctor Aphra faces the consequences of her actions during the droid crisis, leading to a final, explosive confrontation with her allies and enemies. Her story takes a dramatic turn, forever altering her path through the galaxy.

1982.abstract: Seeking to build a new lightsaber, Luke Skywalker travels to the ancient Jedi world of Tython to find a kyber crystal expert. There, he discovers that the planet's connection to the Force is more dangerous and complex than he ever imagined.

1983.abstract: On Tython, Luke Skywalker undergoes intense trials within the planet's powerful Force vergence, confronting visions of his past and future. He must prove his worthiness to construct his new green lightsaber while resisting the dark side's pull.

1984.abstract: Luke's quest for a kyber crystal on Tython leads him into conflict with the planet's ancient, spectral guardians. He must learn to see beyond the physical realm to find what he seeks and survive the experience.

1985.abstract: During the Clone Wars, Jedi Master Mace Windu investigates a mysterious cult on the planet Ridlay that claims to have unlocked the secrets of eternal life. He must uncover the truth behind their power before it can be exploited by the Separatists.

1986.abstract: Luke Skywalker faces his final trial on Tython and successfully attunes a kyber crystal, which turns green, marking a pivotal step in his journey to becoming a Jedi Knight. Elsewhere, Lando Calrissian confronts the difficult reality of Lobot's condition after saving him from the Scourge.

1987.abstract: Lando Calrissian faces a trial for his past actions, forcing his friends in the Rebel Alliance to confront uncomfortable truths and dangerous enemies to save him.

1988.abstract: As Lando Calrissian's trial continues, Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa uncover a deeper conspiracy, fighting against time and a biased system to prove their friend's innocence.

1989.abstract: The verdict of Lando Calrissian's trial looms, forcing the Rebels into a desperate gambit that pits them against both the law and the criminal underworld.

1990.abstract: The explosive conclusion to Lando's trial sees the Rebels make their final move, with the fate of their friend and the stability of the sector hanging in the balance.

1991.abstract: The Lepi smuggler Jaxxon T. Tumperakki finds himself caught between Imperial forces and a local resistance while on a seemingly simple job.

1992.abstract: Darth Vader hunts the traitorous Imperial faction known as the Schism Imperial, confronting their advanced technology and fanatical devotion to the Emperor.

1993.abstract: The Schism Imperial springs a trap for Darth Vader, forcing the Sith Lord to unleash his full power against his own former allies and their deadly droids.

1994.abstract: Darth Vader closes in on the leaders of the Schism Imperial, while Sabé's loyalty is tested as she witnesses the depths of his cruelty.

1995.abstract: In a final confrontation, Darth Vader crushes the last remnants of the Schism Imperial, reasserting his authority as the Emperor's fist.

1996.abstract: During the High Republic era, Jedi Master Tal Bota investigates a mysterious affliction plaguing a remote world, uncovering a danger rooted in the planet itself.

1997.abstract: Darth Vader returns to Mustafar to oversee the construction of his fortress, but the dark side energies of the planet and its hostile inhabitants prove to be formidable obstacles.

1998.abstract: As Fortress Vader rises, the Sith Lord must tame the fiery world of Mustafar, battling its monstrous creatures and bending its very essence to his will.

1999.abstract: An ancient Mustafarian threat emerges from the lava flows to challenge Darth Vader's claim to the planet, leading to a brutal conflict for dominance.

2000.abstract: Darth Vader delves deep beneath his fortress, seeking to corrupt a locus of the dark side to power his new sanctum and further his own dark ambitions.

2001.abstract: With his fortress complete and the planet of Mustafar subjugated, Darth Vader solidifies his power base, creating a monument to his pain and a weapon for the dark side.

2002.abstract: In a seedy cantina, the notorious Lepi smuggler Jaxxon T. Tumperakki recounts some of his most unbelievable (and likely exaggerated) adventures from across the galaxy.

2003.abstract: The cyborg bounty hunter Valance the Undefeated has a tense and violent encounter with the fast-talking smuggler Jaxxon T. Tumperakki aboard a notorious gambling station.

2004.abstract: In a final, desperate act, the cyborg bounty hunter Beilert Valance makes his last stand against Darth Vader aboard the Executor, seeking to save his friends and find redemption.

2005.abstract: The fearsome Darth Vader demonstrates the overwhelming power of the Galactic Empire as he relentlessly pursues the stolen Death Star plans.

2006.abstract: Centuries before the Rebel Alliance, Maz Kanata recounts an adventure on the icy planet of Hoth, where she and her companions faced a deadly predator.

2007.abstract: A young Wookiee learns a lesson about courage and tradition during a Life Day celebration when the story of a fearsome Kroolok beast is told.

2008.abstract: A group of young Ewok woklings get into mischief in the forests of Endor, learning a valuable lesson about the dangers that lurk beyond their village.

2009.abstract: The Ewok scout Paploo recounts one of his daring adventures, showcasing the bravery and resourcefulness of his people in the face of danger.

2010.abstract: An Imperial officer aboard the second Death Star struggles to motivate his subordinates and meet the demanding expectations of his superiors.

2011.abstract: An Imperial officer stationed on the forest moon of Endor grapples with his duty and the escalating conflict as the Rebel Alliance launches its desperate attack on the shield generator.

2012.abstract: Princess Leia Organa leads a small team on a dangerous diversionary mission across the Outer Rim to draw Imperial attention away from the Rebel fleet gathering at Sullust.

2013.abstract: While on a diplomatic mission, Princess Leia Organa must use her wits and courage to help a group of endangered creatures escape from poachers.

2014.abstract: Lando Calrissian goes undercover in the grime and villainy of Jabba the Hutt's palace, navigating treacherous alliances in a high-stakes mission to help rescue Han Solo.

2015.abstract: Luke Skywalker and Princess Leia Organa undertake a diplomatic mission to the watery world of Ikkrukk, only to find themselves caught in the middle of an Imperial plot.

2016.abstract: A tale from the dark history of the galaxy reveals more about the mysterious and terrifying creatures known as the Nameless and the dread they inspire.

2017.abstract: While searching for a new Rebel base, Luke Skywalker is stranded on a remote world and must rely on his wits and the Force to survive an Imperial patrol.

2018.abstract: At Black Spire Outpost on the remote world of Batuu, smugglers, bounty hunters, and spies clash over ancient artifacts and hidden secrets from the days of the Empire.

2019.abstract: At Black Spire Outpost on the remote world of Batuu, smugglers, bounty hunters, and spies clash over ancient artifacts and hidden secrets from the days of the Empire.

2023.abstract: Imperial Special Forces Commander Iden Versio leads Inferno Squad in a mission to retrieve vital intelligence from a Rebel cruiser during the Battle of Endor.

2024.abstract: While on a supply run, Princess Leia Organa and Sabine Wren are targeted by the assassin droid IG-88, forcing them to work together to survive.

2025.abstract: During the retreat from Hoth, Princess Leia Organa must make a difficult choice on the desolate world of Crait, a place that once housed a Rebel outpost.

2026.abstract: A collection of terrifying tales from across the galaxy, including the story of the heartbroken keeper of Jabba the Hutt's rancor and a Jedi monster hunter's chilling encounter.

2027.abstract: An Ewok shaman recounts a cautionary tale to the younglings of Bright Tree Village about a legendary monster known as the Griagh.

2028.abstract: The Ewok scout Wicket W. Warrick and his companions set a trap for Imperial invaders, only to find their prey is more cunning than they anticipated.

2029.abstract: An Imperial stormtrooper, part of the garrison on Endor, finds his duty and survival skills tested by the moon's hostile environment and native inhabitants.

2030.abstract: On the eve of a decisive battle, the leadership of the Rebel Alliance briefs its assembled forces on the daring plan to destroy the second Death Star.

2031.abstract: The ancient and powerful Sarlacc, dwelling in the Great Pit of Carkoon, senses the arrival of new prey and reflects on its long existence.

2032.abstract: Two of Jabba the Hutt's enforcers, Valnir and Laizhu, carry out their master's brutal will in the shadowy corners of his palace.

2033.abstract: Luke Skywalker and the Rebel Alliance launch a final, desperate assault against the Galactic Empire, confronting Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader aboard a new, more powerful Death Star.

2034.abstract: The final confrontation between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire unfolds as Luke Skywalker faces his destiny and his father, Darth Vader.

2043.abstract: The final confrontation between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire unfolds as Luke Skywalker faces his destiny and his father, Darth Vader.

2044.abstract: Jabba the Hutt's majordomo, Bib Fortuna, navigates the treacherous politics and dangers of his master's court while pursuing his own ambitions.

2045.abstract: Droids C-3PO and R2-D2 are delivered to the vile gangster Jabba the Hutt as part of a larger, secret plan to rescue Han Solo.

2046.abstract: Princess Leia, disguised as a bounty hunter, infiltrates the palace of Jabba the Hutt in a daring attempt to free Han Solo from carbonite.

2047.abstract: Princess Leia, disguised as a bounty hunter, infiltrates the palace of Jabba the Hutt in a daring attempt to free Han Solo from carbonite.

2048.abstract: The notorious crime lord Jabba the Hutt rules his criminal empire from his desert palace, unaware of the heroes plotting his downfall.

2049.abstract: Princess Leia, disguised as a bounty hunter, infiltrates the palace of Jabba the Hutt in a daring attempt to free Han Solo from carbonite.

2050.abstract: Within the decadent and dangerous court of Jabba the Hutt, various schemes and plots unfold as the gangster's captives and courtiers vie for survival and power.

2051.abstract: Princess Leia Organa risks everything by infiltrating Jabba the Hutt's palace to rescue her beloved Han Solo from his carbonite prison.

2052.abstract: Captured by Jabba the Hutt, Luke Skywalker and his friends are sentenced to be executed at the Great Pit of Carkoon, home to the monstrous Sarlacc.

2053.abstract: Bib Fortuna reflects on the intricate and often chaotic plans of his master, Jabba the Hutt, and the unexpected arrival of a Jedi Knight.

2054.abstract: Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker faces a monstrous Rancor in the pit beneath Jabba the Hutt's throne room.

2055.abstract: A pair of Gamorrean guards in Jabba's Palace find their simple duties complicated by the arrival of a Jedi and the ensuing chaos.

2056.abstract: Bib Fortuna attempts to manage the escalating crisis in Jabba's Palace as a Jedi Knight's arrival throws everything into disarray.

2057.abstract: Sy Snootles, lead singer of the Max Rebo Band, plots her escape from servitude to Jabba the Hutt during the gangster's final, fateful party.

2058.abstract: The infamous bounty hunter Boba Fett finds his formidable reputation put to the test during the chaotic battle at the Great Pit of Carkoon.

2059.abstract: Luke Skywalker reveals his newly constructed lightsaber, signaling his readiness to confront his enemies and embrace his destiny as a Jedi Knight.

2060.abstract: Luke Skywalker and his friends turn the tables on Jabba the Hutt, leading to a spectacular battle aboard the gangster's sail barge.

2061.abstract: With Han Solo freed, the heroes launch their escape from Jabba's clutches, culminating in a fiery battle above the Sarlacc pit.

2062.abstract: The musician Max Rebo weighs his options and loyalties as chaos erupts in Jabba's Palace and aboard his sail barge.

2063.abstract: Luke Skywalker returns to Dagobah to complete his training, where he learns a final, shocking truth about his family from a dying Master Yoda.

2064.abstract: The Sarlacc experiences the final moments of its victims, including the legendary bounty hunter Boba Fett, adding their consciousness to its own.

2268.abstract: Mandalorian Din Djarin assembles a team of allies to launch a daring assault on Moff Gideon's light cruiser and rescue the Force-sensitive child, Grogu. Their mission culminates in a dramatic confrontation with Dark Troopers and the unexpected arrival of a legendary Jedi Master.

2269.abstract: In this adaptation, the Mandalorian Din Djarin leads a strike team aboard Moff Gideon's cruiser to rescue Grogu. He faces the formidable Dark Troopers and engages in a Darksaber duel with Gideon before a powerful Jedi answers Grogu's call.

2270.abstract: Having survived the Sarlacc, former bounty hunter Boba Fett returns to Tatooine to claim the criminal empire of his late employer, Jabba the Hutt. He begins to establish his rule in Mos Espa, facing challenges from the city's established powers.

2271.abstract: Having seized control of Mos Espa's criminal underworld, Daimyo Boba Fett navigates the treacherous political landscape of Tatooine. He reflects on his past survival and time with the Tusken Raiders while preparing for a war against the formidable Pyke Syndicate.

2272.abstract: While consolidating his power, Boba Fett recalls his time living among a tribe of Tusken Raiders, learning their ways and helping them combat a deadly spice train. In the present, he faces opposition from the Hutt Twins who also lay claim to Jabba's territory.

2273.abstract: Boba Fett's authority is challenged by the Pyke Syndicate's encroachment on his territory, forcing him to recruit a gang of cybernetically enhanced youths to bolster his forces. His attempts to secure Mos Espa's neutrality are met with defiance and escalating threats.

2274.abstract: As war with the Pyke Syndicate looms, Boba Fett seeks to strengthen his forces by recruiting his former associate, the deadly assassin Fennec Shand. He also recovers his iconic starship to settle old scores and prepare for the coming conflict.

2275.abstract: The Mandalorian Din Djarin, now wielding the Darksaber, seeks out the remnants of his covert to atone for removing his helmet. He acquires a new starship on Tatooine and is recruited by Fennec Shand to aid Boba Fett in his war against the Pykes.

2276.abstract: Din Djarin visits Grogu at Luke Skywalker's new Jedi temple, forcing the child to make a difficult choice about his future. On Tatooine, Marshal Cobb Vanth's stand against the Pykes leads to a tense showdown with the deadly bounty hunter Cad Bane.

2277.abstract: The Pyke Syndicate launches an all-out assault on Mos Espa, forcing Boba Fett and his small band of allies to make a final stand for control of the city. The battle sees the arrival of unexpected reinforcements and a climactic duel between Boba Fett and his old rival, Cad Bane.

2278.abstract: Seeking redemption, Din Djarin begins his quest to bathe in the Living Waters beneath the mines of Mandalore. He travels to Nevarro to repair an old droid ally and visits Bo-Katan Kryze on Kalevala, seeking her guidance for his journey.

2279.abstract: Exiled for removing his helmet, Din Djarin embarks on a perilous quest to Mandalore to redeem himself in the Living Waters. This journey forces him to reunite with Bo-Katan Kryze and confront Imperial remnants, setting in motion the reunification of the Mandalorian people.

2280.abstract: Din Djarin and Grogu venture into the ruined civic center of Sundari on Mandalore to find the Living Waters. After Din is captured by a cyborg creature, Grogu must seek the help of Bo-Katan Kryze to mount a rescue.

2281.abstract: Following their experience in the Living Waters, Bo-Katan escorts an unconscious Din Djarin from Mandalore. Meanwhile, on Coruscant, former Imperial scientist Dr. Penn Pershing undergoes the New Republic's Amnesty Program, only to be drawn into a sinister conspiracy.

2282.abstract: Back at the Mandalorian covert's hidden enclave, a foundling is snatched by a massive winged creature. Bo-Katan Kryze leads a rescue party, earning the respect of the Children of the Watch and sharing her own story of seeing a Mythosaur in the Living Waters.

2283.abstract: High Magistrate Greef Karga's city on Nevarro comes under siege by the pirate king Gorian Shard, forcing him to call for aid from the Mandalorians. Captain Carson Teva investigates the incident, growing concerned about a resurgent Imperial threat in the Outer Rim.

2284.abstract: To unite the scattered Mandalorian tribes, Din Djarin and Bo-Katan travel to the independent world of Plazir-15 to recruit her former Nite Owls. They become embroiled in a local droid malfunction crisis, uncovering a Separatist conspiracy.

2285.abstract: The united Mandalorian fleet travels to Mandalore to scout a location for a new settlement, but they are ambushed by Moff Gideon's new generation of beskar-armored stormtroopers. Din Djarin is captured, forcing Bo-Katan to lead a desperate retreat.

2300.abstract: Bo-Katan Kryze leads the combined Mandalorian forces in a final, desperate battle to liberate their homeworld from Moff Gideon and his Imperial remnant. Din Djarin and Grogu confront Gideon directly to end his threat to their people once and for all.

2301.abstract: Former Jedi Knight Ahsoka Tano captures a key agent of Morgan Elsbeth, seeking a star map that could lead to the location of Grand Admiral Thrawn. On Lothal, Sabine Wren struggles with her past as Ahsoka's apprentice while Imperial loyalists plot to find their lost leader.

2302.abstract: In her search for the lost Grand Admiral Thrawn, Ahsoka Tano tracks down a map on the planet Arcana. She reunites with General Hera Syndulla and her former apprentice, Sabine Wren, on Lothal to decipher its secrets before their enemies can.

2303.abstract: Ahsoka Tano and General Hera Syndulla investigate a secret shipyard on Corellia, uncovering a massive hyperdrive core salvaged from a Super Star Destroyer. Meanwhile, Sabine Wren is captured by the dark side agents Shin Hati and Baylan Skoll, who seek to unlock the map.

2304.abstract: While investigating the enemy's activities, Ahsoka and Hera travel to the Corellian shipyards and discover a massive hyperdrive being constructed for Morgan Elsbeth's vessel. Sabine Wren, having been captured, is forced to help the enemy unlock the map to Thrawn's location.

2305.abstract: Pursuing Morgan Elsbeth's vessel, Ahsoka, Sabine, and Huyang engage in a tense starship battle amidst a pod of purrgil. They are forced to land on the planet Seatos, where Elsbeth's forces are preparing to make the hyperspace jump to another galaxy.

2306.abstract: Ahsoka, Sabine, and Huyang follow Morgan Elsbeth's forces to the planet Seatos, navigating a dangerous asteroid field and a squadron of enemy fighters. On the planet's surface, they prepare to confront Baylan Skoll and Shin Hati to stop them from completing their journey.

2307.abstract: On Seatos, Ahsoka Tano confronts the fallen Jedi Baylan Skoll in a desperate attempt to prevent him from acquiring the map to Thrawn's location. The duel ends with Ahsoka cast into the World Between Worlds, where she is met by a specter from her past.

2308.abstract: While her allies race to prevent Morgan Elsbeth from reaching another galaxy, Ahsoka Tano confronts her former master, Anakin Skywalker, within the World Between Worlds, a mystical realm that transcends time and space.

2309.abstract: Trapped in the World Between Worlds, Ahsoka Tano is guided by a vision of her former master, Anakin Skywalker, through pivotal moments of her past to complete her training and choose to live.

2310.abstract: Within the mystical World Between Worlds, Ahsoka Tano confronts visions of her past with her former master, Anakin Skywalker, ultimately finding the will to continue her fight.

2311.abstract: Arriving in a distant galaxy, Sabine Wren is reunited with Ezra Bridger on the desolate world of Peridea, the ancient Dathomiri homeworld. There, they must contend with the forces of Grand Admiral Thrawn and the Great Mothers.

2312.abstract: In a new galaxy, Sabine Wren finds Ezra Bridger on the planet Peridea, where they must contend with the forces of Grand Admiral Thrawn as he prepares for his return.

2313.abstract: On Peridea, Ahsoka Tano reunites with Ezra Bridger and Sabine Wren to thwart Grand Admiral Thrawn's departure. In the known galaxy, Hera Syndulla's warnings of Thrawn's return are met with skepticism by the New Republic Senate.

2314.abstract: Ahsoka Tano arrives on Peridea to aid her friends against Grand Admiral Thrawn's forces, devising a desperate plan to ensure Ezra Bridger can escape and warn the New Republic.

2315.abstract: In a final confrontation, Ezra Bridger escapes to the known galaxy aboard Thrawn's Star Destroyer, leaving Ahsoka Tano and Sabine Wren stranded on Peridea. Grand Admiral Thrawn arrives at Dathomir, poised to become Heir to the Empire.

2316.abstract: Ahsoka Tano, Sabine Wren, and Ezra Bridger battle Grand Admiral Thrawn's forces to stop his return. While Ezra succeeds in escaping, Ahsoka and Sabine are left behind on the desolate world of Peridea.
