2327.abstract: The escalating war between the fragile New Republic and the Imperial Remnant, led by the returned Grand Admiral Thrawn, threatens to engulf the galaxy.

2328.abstract: A young Poe Dameron, desperate to escape his quiet life, runs away from home and falls in with the dangerous Spice Runners of Kijimi. He must navigate a treacherous criminal underworld while discovering who he truly is.

2329.abstract: Jedi Master Luke Skywalker and General Lando Calrissian race against time to stop the Sith Eternal from enacting their plan for galactic domination. Their quest leads them to the trail of a mysterious Sith assassin and a young family with a powerful secret.

2330.abstract: On the desolate world of Jakku, a former Imperial officer turned junk boss reflects on his past and the brutal realities of survival in the galactic scrapyard.

2331.abstract: Jedi Master Luke Skywalker trains a new student in the ways of the Force, but the young apprentice is haunted by visions of the dark side and the legacy of the Empire.

2332.abstract: Sisters Rose and Paige Tico undertake a perilous mission for the Resistance to a desolate mining world, facing overwhelming odds to help a desperate community against the First Order.

2333.abstract: The heroes of the Rebel Alliance face a galaxy-wide droid uprising orchestrated by a mysterious intelligence known as the Scourge. Luke Skywalker must confront his past and the dark side to save his friends and the galaxy.

2334.abstract: Senator Leia Organa navigates the treacherous politics of the New Republic, uncovering a shadowy conspiracy that threatens to plunge the galaxy back into war. Her efforts are complicated when her secret heritage as the daughter of Darth Vader is exposed.

2335.abstract: After a tragic confrontation with his master, Luke Skywalker, a conflicted Ben Solo flees the destruction of the new Jedi Temple. He seeks out the mysterious Knights of Ren, hoping to find his place in the galaxy.

2336.abstract: Ben Solo tracks down the Knights of Ren and their leader, Ren, seeking to join their ranks. He must prove his worth and his commitment to the dark side to be accepted.

2337.abstract: On a mission with the Knights of Ren to the planet Minemoon, Ben Solo is confronted by his former Jedi classmates. He is forced to make a choice between his past and his dark future.

2338.abstract: Ben Solo fully embraces the dark side, killing the leader of the Knights of Ren and claiming his new name: Kylo Ren. He bleeds his kyber crystal, forging the unstable crossguard lightsaber that will become his signature weapon.

2339.abstract: The infamous pirate Hondo Ohnaka recounts a tale of a daring heist and a narrow escape, embellishing the truth as only he can to a captive audience at Oga's Cantina.

2340.abstract: Supreme Leader Snoke takes his apprentice, Kylo Ren, to the dark side cave on Dagobah to complete his training. There, Kylo must confront a vision of his master, Luke Skywalker, and his parents.

2341.abstract: Maz Kanata hires a pair of roguish scoundrels for a seemingly simple job on the planet Parnassos, but the mission quickly becomes more complicated than they bargained for.

2342.abstract: A collection of myths and tall tales about the legendary Jedi Master Luke Skywalker are shared among travelers aboard a cargo freighter. The stories depict his heroic deeds, from battling mythical creatures to exploring the deepest mysteries of the Force.

2343.abstract: A scavenger on Jakku recounts a tale of how Luke Skywalker, using only the Force, brought down a Star Destroyer during the final battle above the planet.

2344.abstract: A former Imperial medical droid tells the story of its encounter with Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker, who showed it compassion and a new purpose.

2345.abstract: A tiny, Force-sensitive flea-like creature living on Salacious Crumb recounts its perspective of Luke Skywalker's daring rescue of his friends from Jabba the Hutt.

2346.abstract: A biologist tells a fantastical story of being swallowed by a giant Exogorth, only to be rescued by Luke Skywalker who was exploring the creature's interior ecosystem.

2347.abstract: The constable of Niima Outpost on Jakku must face down a notorious gang leader in a classic showdown to protect the town's meager water supply.

2348.abstract: On the desert world of Jakku, the mysterious storyteller Bobbajo gathers a menagerie of strange creatures, sharing his tales with the local children and offering a glimmer of wonder in a harsh land.

2349.abstract: A scavenger on Jakku encounters the menacing Melitto male Sarco Plank, discovering the dark history and ruthless nature that lies behind his insectoid mask.

2350.abstract: Two of Unkar Plutt's brutish enforcers, Thromba and Laparo, find an unexpected and violent connection amidst the desolate wastes of Jakku.

2351.abstract: A New Republic pilot reflects on a past mission to the planet Bakura, a world still haunted by the legacy of the Ssi-ruuvi Imperium and the Galactic Empire.

2352.abstract: The scavenger and tomb raider Sarco Plank travels to the storm-wracked world of Eadu in search of a valuable artifact, only to find more danger than he bargained for.

2353.abstract: The skilled mercenary Bazine Netal is hired by a mysterious client to retrieve a mysterious package from the care of a former stormtrooper, a mission that tests her deadly skills to their limit.

2354.abstract: The infamous pirate captain Sidon Ithano and his crew follow a century-old clue to the lost treasure of Count Dooku, leading them to a crashed Separatist dreadnought on a forgotten desert world.

2355.abstract: From her castle on Takodana, Maz Kanata recounts tales of the Millennium Falcon's storied past, from its days in the Clone Wars to its role in the Galactic Civil War, to a group of eager listeners.

2360.abstract: Han Solo and Chewbacca race against time and bounty hunters to make it to Kashyyyk for Life Day, encountering trouble at every turn in their festive journey home.

2361.abstract: The Crimson Corsair, Sidon Ithano, finds himself caught in a deadly game between rival crime lords on the barren world of Vask, forcing him to use his wits to survive.

2363.abstract: As a commander in the New Republic Navy, Poe Dameron learns a valuable lesson in leadership and perspective from the eccentric Vice Admiral Amilyn Holdo during a mission to the neutral world of Cerea.

2364.abstract: While on a mission to the jungle world of Devaron, Rey and Chewbacca must rescue a kidnapped R2-D2 from a group of bumbling criminals.

2365.abstract: The lives of three heroes are explored before their fateful meeting: a stormtrooper's crisis of conscience, a scavenger's lonely existence, and a daring pilot's rise in the Resistance.

2366.abstract: Resistance pilot Poe Dameron and his droid BB-8 travel to the planet Ovanis to investigate the disappearance of a vital Resistance transport ship.

2367.abstract: Sisters Rose and Paige Tico defend their home mining colony from the First Order, a selfless act of bravery that ultimately leads them to join the Resistance.

2368.abstract: Stranded on a hostile world, Captain Phasma is forced into a temporary and uneasy alliance with a Wookiee warrior to survive the dangerous local fauna and find a way off-world.

2369.abstract: At the Resistance base on D'Qar, BB-8 engages in a bit of playful sabotage against a fellow astromech droid to ensure he gets to accompany Poe Dameron on his next mission.

2370.abstract: Commander Poe Dameron and his Black Squadron infiltrate a high-security mobile prison to rescue a vital informant who may hold the key to locating the elusive Lor San Tekka.

2373.abstract: Trapped within the Megalox prison with a First Order agent on their tail, Poe Dameron and his squadron must stage a daring escape while protecting their valuable asset.

2376.abstract: After a disastrous crash on a hostile planet, C-3PO and a group of captured droids must work together to survive, leading to a profound sacrifice and the origin of his red arm.

2377.abstract: Stranded on the dangerous planet Taul, C-3PO recounts the story of his new red arm, a memento of a brave droid who made the ultimate sacrifice for his friends.

2378.abstract: A restless teenager with the rare ability to see echoes of the past through the Force embarks on a galactic journey to understand his powers and the forgotten history of the Jedi.

2380.abstract: While serving as a sanitation worker on Starkiller Base, stormtrooper FN-2187's compassion is tested when he and his squadmates are tasked with clearing out a nest of dangerous creatures.

2381.abstract: On the Colossus platform, BB-8 rallies a group of droids to stand up to a bullying security droid, proving that even the smallest heroes can make a big difference.

2382.abstract: After crash-landing on a desolate planet, General Hux and Kylo Ren must rely on each other for survival, a tense situation that exposes the deep rivalry between the two First Order leaders.

2383.abstract: Kylo Ren leads a contingent of First Order stormtroopers on a mission to secure a strategic planet, demonstrating his raw power and ruthless command to his subordinates and his grandfather's helmet.

2384.abstract: Han Solo and Chewbacca take on a seemingly simple job for Maz Kanata, only to find themselves caught in the middle of a local conflict on the planet Spira.

2385.abstract: Han Solo and Chewbacca take on a seemingly simple job for Maz Kanata, only to find themselves caught in the middle of a local conflict on the planet Spira.

2386.abstract: Living a lonely life as a scavenger on Jakku, Rey discovers a derelict flight simulator and escapes her harsh reality by dreaming of flying among the stars.

2387.abstract: Cadet FN-2187 excels in his training simulations aboard a First Order Star Destroyer, but his growing empathy for others sets him apart from his fellow stormtroopers.

2388.abstract: A group of young recruits, including the talented pilot Mattis Banz, undertakes vital missions for the Resistance against the growing threat of the First Order.

2389.abstract: Commander Poe Dameron and his Black Squadron must break a vital Resistance operative out of the inescapable Megalox Beta prison, a facility run by the First Order's Agent Terex.

2390.abstract: Following a daring prison break, Poe Dameron and Black Squadron return to the Resistance base on D'Qar to regroup and deal with the fallout of their mission.

2391.abstract: As Agent Terex's machinations continue to threaten the Resistance, Poe Dameron and General Organa strategize their next move from the D'Qar base.

2392.abstract: The journalist Suralinda Javos arrives on D'Qar, bringing with her information that could expose the First Order's funding, but her presence complicates matters for Poe Dameron.

2393.abstract: Poe Dameron and Black Squadron deal with internal conflicts and the presence of a journalist while the First Order's threat looms larger.

2394.abstract: Tensions rise on D'Qar as Poe Dameron confronts the consequences of his past actions and prepares Black Squadron for their next critical mission.

2395.abstract: The First Order's grip tightens across the galaxy, forcing Poe Dameron and the Resistance to consider increasingly desperate measures to fight back.

2396.abstract: General Organa dispatches Poe Dameron and Black Squadron on a secret mission to Cato Neimoidia to uncover the secrets of a traitor from the days of the Empire.

2397.abstract: While investigating a potential traitor on Cato Neimoidia, Poe Dameron and his squadron are ambushed by the forces of Commander Malarus and the First Order.

2398.abstract: Trapped on Cato Neimoidia, Poe Dameron must lead Black Squadron in a desperate fight for survival against overwhelming First Order forces.

2399.abstract: After their harrowing mission to Cato Neimoidia, Black Squadron returns to D'Qar to mourn their losses and report their findings to General Organa.

2400.abstract: Poe Dameron struggles with the costs of war and leadership as the Resistance analyzes the intelligence gathered from their recent costly mission.

2401.abstract: As the First Order closes in, Poe Dameron must rally the fractured Black Squadron for what may be their final stand at the D'Qar base.

2402.abstract: Poe Dameron recounts a past adventure on the planet Kaddak, where a reunion with an old flame, Suralinda Javos, led to a dangerous confrontation with local criminals.

2403.abstract: Poe Dameron and Finn go undercover on the rainy world of Eadu to investigate a potential First Order sympathizer within a powerful corporation.

2404.abstract: In his search for Lor San Tekka, Poe Dameron travels to the planet Pastoria, where he seeks the help of a Force-sensitive Chieftain.

2405.abstract: On Pastoria, Poe Dameron and his squadron must prove their worth to the planet's Force-sensitive inhabitants while being hunted by Agent Terex and the First Order.

2406.abstract: Poe Dameron delves deeper into the mysteries of the Force on Pastoria, facing trials that test his resolve and his connection to the light.

2407.abstract: The First Order launches a full-scale assault on Pastoria, forcing Poe Dameron and Black Squadron to defend the planet's sacred sites.

2408.abstract: As the battle for Pastoria rages, Poe Dameron confronts Agent Terex in a final showdown for the fate of the planet and its secrets.

2409.abstract: With the search for Lor San Tekka concluded, Poe Dameron returns to D'Qar, setting the stage for his fateful mission to Jakku.

2429.abstract: Kazuda Xiono and Poe Dameron investigate a distress signal from a derelict freighter, only to discover it's infested with monstrous fyrnocks.

2430.abstract: A young New Republic pilot, Kazuda Xiono, is recruited by Poe Dameron for a top-secret Resistance mission to spy on the First Order from the Colossus refueling platform.

2431.abstract: The astromech droid BB-8 searches the bustling Colossus platform for its new, and often clumsy, companion, Kazuda Xiono.

2432.abstract: Pirate spy Synara San attempts to sabotage the Colossus's defenses to prove her loyalty to Kragan Gorr, but her growing connection to the platform's inhabitants complicates her mission.

2433.abstract: A legendary and dangerous race, the Platform Classic, tests the skills of the Colossus's best pilots, including Jarek Yeager, who is forced to confront his past.

2434.abstract: Kazuda Xiono struggles to find a secure way to transmit a message to the Resistance, leading him to uncover secrets about Captain Doza's past and his connections.

2435.abstract: Kazuda Xiono joins Poe Dameron on a dangerous mission to investigate a mysterious First Order mining facility, Station Theta Black, uncovering a sinister secret.

2436.abstract: The top pilots of the Colossus, the Aces, engage in a friendly but fierce competition to determine who is truly the best flyer on the station.

2437.abstract: Neeku Vozo befriends a strange, fast-growing creature, causing chaos on the Colossus until its protective parent arrives seeking its child.

2438.abstract: In need of credits, Kazuda Xiono takes a job for a suspicious shop owner, only to find himself entangled in a dangerous deal involving a volatile substance and the station's pirates.

2439.abstract: Kazuda Xiono's attempt to fix a simple droid dart board goes comically wrong, causing it to malfunction and fire wildly throughout Yeager's garage.

2440.abstract: After Neeku Vozo helps a customer, he is offered a strange, wriggling creature as a reward, much to the dismay of his co-workers.

2441.abstract: The old astromech Bucket embarks on a determined quest across the Colossus to find a specific, rare bolt needed for repairs in Yeager's garage.

2442.abstract: A pair of mischievous Gorgs infiltrate Yeager's garage, causing chaos and stealing parts while the crew is distracted.

2443.abstract: Kazuda Xiono discovers a locked chest in the garage and imagines it's full of treasure, only to find its contents are far more mundane than he hoped.

2444.abstract: A cleaning droid named G-LN goes to extreme lengths to keep the garage spotless, creating more problems than it solves for the mechanics.

2445.abstract: Jarek Yeager struggles to get his unmotivated pit droids to work, resorting to various tactics to get them to perform a simple task.

2446.abstract: Ace pilot Hype Fazon shows off his high-speed flying skills, much to the annoyance of his fellow Aces who are trying to relax.

2447.abstract: Following their official race, Jarek Yeager and his old rival Marcus Speedstar engage in a small, personal rematch to truly settle the score.

2448.abstract: Kazuda Xiono accidentally activates a training droid's self-destruct sequence, forcing him and BB-8 to frantically try to disarm it before it explodes.

2449.abstract: Torra Doza's pet voorpak, Buggles, escapes from her quarters and leads her on a merry chase through the corridors of the Colossus.

2450.abstract: The First Order pressures Captain Doza to accept their protection, forcing him into a difficult position as pirate attacks, secretly orchestrated by the First Order, escalate.

2451.abstract: Kazuda Xiono and BB-8 investigate a supposedly haunted sector of the Colossus, only to discover the 'ghosts' are just mischievous droids.

2452.abstract: The First Order arrives on the Colossus, claiming to offer protection but quickly establishing an oppressive military occupation of the station.

2453.abstract: A captured Resistance spy recounts the brutal history of Captain Phasma, detailing her treacherous rise to power from a primitive, post-apocalyptic world to a high-ranking First Order officer.

2454.abstract: When a friend of the station's children is captured and conscripted by the First Order, Kazuda Xiono and his friends devise a plan to rescue him from the stormtroopers.

2455.abstract: Bomber pilot Paige Tico and her gunner sister Rose face overwhelming odds as they struggle to protect a new Resistance base and its inhabitants from a relentless First Order attack.

2456.abstract: Sisters Rose and Paige Tico use their unique skills and unbreakable bond to serve the Resistance, with Rose as a technician and Paige as a brave bomber pilot.
